title.zh: 卷15 本紀十五 高宗本紀六
title.raw: 卷15 本紀十五 高宗本紀六

sentences.zh: 五十一年春正月丙午朔，日食，免朝賀。

translations.literal: Fifty-first year, spring, first month, new moon on day bingwu: there was a solar eclipse; court congratulations were dispensed with.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 51, on the first-month new moon, bingwu, an eclipse canceled court congratulations.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命戶部撥銀一百萬兩解往安徽備賑。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to allocate one million taels of silver to be sent to Anhui for disaster-relief preparation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Revenue allocated one million taels for Anhui famine relief.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，禮部尚書姚成烈卒，以彭元瑞代之。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Minister of Rites Yao Chenglie died; Peng Yuanrui was appointed to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Yao Chenglie died; Peng Yuanrui took the rites ministry.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以普福為駐藏大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Pufu was made Tibet resident commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Pufu became Tibet resident commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，江西巡撫何裕城奏糧價日昂，由江、楚販運過多所致。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Jiangxi Governor He Yucheng memorialized that grain prices rose daily, caused by excessive trafficking from Jiang and Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, He Yucheng blamed Jiang-Chu grain trafficking for rising Jiangxi prices.

sentences.zh: 上以意存遏糴，切責之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, minded to restrain grain hoarding, rebuked him severely.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli, intent on curbing hoarding, rebuked him sharply.

sentences.zh: 命范建中往哈密辦事。

translations.literal: Fan Jianzhong was ordered to go to Hami on business.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Jianzhong was sent to Hami.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，上御經筵賜宴，命工歌新譜抑戒詩，歲為例。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengchen: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture and granted a feast, ordering craftsmen to sing newly composed admonitory restraint verses—the practice was made annual.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, gengchen, Hongli lectured, feasted, and made annual the singing of new admonitory verses.

sentences.zh: 加福建水師提督黃仕簡太子太保。

translations.literal: Fujian naval commander Huang Shijian was additionally granted the rank of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Shijian was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the enclosure hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Hongli hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命尚書曹文埴，侍郎姜晟、伊齡阿往浙省盤查倉庫。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Ministers Cao Wenpei, Jiang Sheng, and Yiling'a were ordered to go to Zhejiang to audit granaries and storehouses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Cao Wenpei, Jiang Sheng, and Yiling'a were sent to audit Zhejiang granaries.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上詣西陵，巡幸五台山，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor went to the Western Tombs, made a progress tour of Mount Wutai, and remitted one-tenth of quota taxes for places along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Hongli worshipped at the Western Tombs, toured Wutai, and forgave a tenth of route taxes.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上謁泰陵、泰東陵。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor paid rites at Tailing and Tai East Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Hongli worshipped at Tailing and Tai East Tombs.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免直隸順德、廣平、大名三府屬上年災欠銀米。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, last year's disaster arrears in silver and grain were remitted for subordinate districts of three Zhili prefectures—Shunde, Guangping, and Daming.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Shunde, Guangping, and Daming lost last year's disaster arrears.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以圖薩布為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Tusaibu was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Tusaibu took Hubei.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，免山西忻州等六州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day guimao, tax arrears were remitted for six prefectures and counties in Shanxi including Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, six Shanxi districts including Xinzhou lost tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，上駐蹕五台山。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingwu: the Emperor halted at Mount Wutai.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, bingwu, Hongli halted at Mount Wutai.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，兩江總督薩載卒，調李世傑代之。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Liang-Jiang Governor-General Sa Zai died; Li Shijie was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Sa Zai died; Li Shijie took Liang-Jiang.

sentences.zh: 以保寧為四川總督，鄂輝為成都將軍。

translations.literal: Baoning was made Sichuan governor-general; Ehui was made Chengdu general.
translations.idiomatic: Baoning took Sichuan; Ehui, Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 己未，上閱滹沱河，閱正定鎮兵。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor inspected the Hutuo River and reviewed troops at Zhengding garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Hongli inspected the Hutuo and Zhengding troops.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上祭帝堯廟。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor sacrificed at the temple of Emperor Yao.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Hongli sacrificed at the Yao temple.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命李侍堯署戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Li Shiyao was ordered to act as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Li Shiyao acted as revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賑陝西朝邑等三縣災民。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, disaster victims in three counties in Shaanxi including Chaoyi were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, three Shaanxi counties including Chaoyi received relief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Hongli returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以伊齡阿為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Yiling'a was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Yiling'a took Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，命大學士阿桂往江南籌辦河工。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jimao: Grand Secretary Agui was ordered to go to Jiangnan to plan river works.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, jimao, Agui was sent to Jiangnan for river works.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，浙江學政竇光鼐奏嘉興、海鹽、平陽三縣虧空各逾十萬，郡縣採買倉儲，俱折收銀兩，以便挪移。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Zhejiang education intendant Dou Guangnong memorialized that deficits in Jiaxing, Haiyan, and Pingyang counties each exceeded 100,000; prefectures and counties purchasing for granary storage all collected in silver for ease of diversion.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Dou Guangnong reported 100,000-tael deficits in three Zhejiang counties and silver collection for granary purchases.

sentences.zh: 命曹文埴等嚴查覆奏。

translations.literal: Cao Wenpei and others were ordered to investigate strictly and report back.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Wenpei and others were ordered to investigate and report.

sentences.zh: 賑山西代州等六州縣水災。

translations.literal: Water disaster relief was given for six prefectures and counties in Shanxi including Daizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Six Shanxi districts including Daizhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命竇光鼐會同曹文埴等查辦浙江虧空。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Dou Guangnong was ordered to join Cao Wenpei and others in investigating and handling Zhejiang deficits.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Dou Guangnong joined Cao Wenpei in investigating Zhejiang deficits.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，命阿桂赴浙，會同曹文埴等查辦虧空，並勘海塘。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingwu: Agui was ordered to go to Zhejiang, join Cao Wenpei and others in investigating deficits, and survey sea dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, bingwu, Agui was sent to Zhejiang to probe deficits and survey sea dikes.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，富勒渾褫職，交阿桂等審訊。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Fulehun was stripped of office and handed over to Agui and others for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Fulehun was stripped and handed to Agui for trial.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以孫士毅為兩廣總督，調圖薩布為廣東巡撫，以李封為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Sun Shiyi was made Liang-Guang governor-general; Tusaibu was transferred to be Guangdong governor; Li Feng was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Sun Shiyi took Liang-Guang; Tusaibu, Guangdong; Li Feng, Hubei.

sentences.zh: 己未，以李侍堯署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Li Shiyao was ordered to act as Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Li Shiyao acted as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Hongli went to the Mulan autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 賑四川打箭爐等地震災。

translations.literal: Earthquake disaster relief was given for Dajianlu and elsewhere in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Dajianlu and other Sichuan earthquake districts received relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，免江蘇上元等五十六州縣衛上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: That month, last year's drought quota taxes were remitted for fifty-six prefectures, counties, and guards in Jiangsu including Shangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, fifty-six Jiangsu districts including Shangyuan lost last year's drought taxes.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingchou: the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Escaping Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, dingchou, Hongli reached the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以福崧署山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Fusong was ordered to act as Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Fusong acted as Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，湖南常德府沅江溢。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Yuan River overflowed in Changde prefecture, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Yuan overflowed at Changde, Hunan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，調富綱為閩浙總督，以特成額為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Fu Gang was transferred to be Min-Zhe governor-general; Tekse was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Fu Gang took Min-Zhe and Tekse Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 以畢沅為湖廣總督，江蘭為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Bi Yuan was made Huguang governor-general; Jiang Lan was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Bi Yuan took Huguang; Jiang Lan, Henan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，免河南商丘等十二州縣上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wushen: last year's drought quota taxes were remitted for twelve prefectures and counties in Henan including Shangqiu.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, wushen, twelve Henan districts including Shangqiu lost last year's drought taxes.

sentences.zh: 壬子，江蘇清河李家莊河溢。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the river overflowed at Li Family Estate, Qinghe, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Qinghe breached at Li Family Estate.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命阿桂由浙江赴清口，會同李世傑等辦理堵築事宜。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Agui was ordered to proceed from Zhejiang to Qingkou, join Li Shijie and others in handling damming and embankment work.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Agui was sent from Zhejiang to Qingkou with Li Shijie to dam the breach.

sentences.zh: 己巳，曹錫寶劾和珅家人劉全，不能指實，加恩革職留任。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Cao Xibao impeached Heshen's servant Liu Quan but could not substantiate it; by grace he was dismissed from office but retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Cao Xibao failed to prove charges against Heshen's servant Liu Quan and was dismissed yet kept in post.

sentences.zh: 閏七月庚辰，大學士、伯伍彌泰卒。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day gengchen: Grand Secretary and Baron Wumitai died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, gengchen, Baron Wumitai died.

sentences.zh: 召劉秉恬來京，以譚尚忠為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Liu Bingtian was summoned to the capital; Tan Shangzhong was made Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bingtian was recalled; Tan Shangzhong took Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，浙江學政、吏部右侍郎竇光鼐褫職。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Zhejiang education intendant and Right Vice Minister of Personnel Dou Guangnong was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Dou Guangnong lost his posts as Zhejiang intendant and personnel vice minister.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，富勒渾論斬。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Fulehun was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Fulehun was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命和珅為文華殿大學士，管理戶部事。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Heshen was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory and ordered to manage Revenue affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Heshen joined the Wenhua Grand Secretariat and took charge of revenue.

sentences.zh: 福康安為吏部尚書、協辦大學士，仍留陝甘總督任。

translations.literal: Fukang'an was made Minister of Personnel and Associate Grand Secretary, remaining at his post as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an became personnel minister and associate grand secretary while staying at Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 福長安為戶部尚書，綽克托署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Fu Chang'an was made Minister of Revenue; Chuoketuo was ordered to act as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Chang'an took revenue; Chuoketuo acted at war.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賑湖南武陵、龍陽水災。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, relief was given for flood disaster in Wuling and Longyang, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Wuling and Longyang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingchen: the Emperor went to Mulan for the enclosure hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, bingchen, Hongli hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，調嵩椿為綏遠城將軍，積福為寧夏將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Songchun was transferred to be Suiyuan garrison general; Jifu was made Ningxia general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Songchun took Suiyuan and Jifu, Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuyin: the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Escaping Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, wuyin, Hongli returned to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以勒保為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Lebao was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Lebao took Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以永保為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Yongbao was made Tarbagatai deputy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Yongbao became Tarbagatai deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以巴延三為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Bayansan was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Bayansan took Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Hongli returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甲午，調福長安署兵部尚書，以綽克托署戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Fu Chang'an was transferred to act as Minister of War; Chuoketuo was ordered to act as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Fu Chang'an acted at war and Chuoketuo at revenue.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以琅玕為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Langgan was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Langgan took Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，皇長孫貝勒綿德卒。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor's eldest grandson, Beile Miande, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Beile Miande, the eldest imperial grandson, died.

sentences.zh: 賑安徽五河等十七州縣並鳳陽等五衛水災。

translations.literal: Flood disaster relief was given for seventeen prefectures and counties in Anhui including Wuhe and five guards including Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen Anhui counties and five guards including Fengyang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑朔，調富綱為雲貴總督，以常青為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on day xinchou: Fu Gang was transferred to be Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Changqing was made Min-Zhe governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth-month new moon, Fu Gang took Yunnan-Guizhou and Changqing Min-Zhe.

sentences.zh: 丁未，降畢沅仍為河南巡撫，江蘭仍為河南布政使，授李侍堯湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Bi Yuan was demoted to Henan governor again; Jiang Lan to Henan provincial administration commissioner again; Li Shiyao was appointed Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Bi Yuan and Jiang Lan were demoted in Henan and Li Shiyao took Huguang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，免直隸安州等四州縣被災額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, quota taxes were remitted with differing amounts for disaster in four prefectures and counties in Zhili including Anzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, four Zhili disaster counties including Anzhou lost taxes by degree.

sentences.zh: 十一月，賑安徽合肥等十七州縣水災。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: flood disaster relief was given for seventeen prefectures and counties in Anhui including Hefei.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, seventeen Anhui counties including Hefei received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，福建南靖縣匪徒陳薦等作亂，捕治之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinchou: bandits Chen Jian and others in Nanjing county, Fujian, made trouble; they were captured and punished.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, xinchou, Chen Jian's gang in Nanjing county was captured.

sentences.zh: 壬子，大學士梁國治卒。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Grand Secretary Liang Guozhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Liang Guozhi died.

sentences.zh: 命兵部尚書王傑在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: Minister of War Wang Jie was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jie joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 戊午，封鄭華為暹羅國王。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Zheng Hua was enfeoffed as King of Siam.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Zheng Hua was enfeoffed king of Siam.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，福建彰化縣賊匪林爽文作亂，陷縣城，知縣俞峻死之。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, bandit Lin Shuangwen in Zhanghua county, Fujian, made trouble, captured the county seat; Magistrate Yu Jun died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Lin Shuangwen seized Zhanghua and Magistrate Yu Jun fell.

sentences.zh: 命常青、徐嗣曾等剿辦。

translations.literal: Changqing, Xu Siceng, and others were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Changqing and Xu Siceng were ordered to suppress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球、暹羅來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam sent tribute that year.

sentences.zh: 五十二年春正月辛未，林爽文陷諸羅竹塹。

translations.literal: Fifty-second year, spring, first month, day xinwei: Lin Shuangwen captured Zhuluo and Zhuzhai.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 52, xinwei, Lin Shuangwen took Zhuluo and Zhuzhai.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命鄂輝署四川總督。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Ehui was ordered to act as Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Ehui acted as Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宥富勒渾罪。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Fulehun's crime was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Fulehun was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，調李侍堯為閩浙總督，常青為湖廣總督，仍留福建督辦軍務，命舒常署之。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Li Shiyao was transferred to be Min-Zhe governor-general; Changqing to Huguang governor-general, remaining in Fujian to supervise military affairs; Shu Chang was ordered to act for him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Li Shiyao took Min-Zhe, Changqing Huguang while staying in Fujian, and Shu Chang acted for him.

sentences.zh: 癸未，林爽文陷鳳山，知縣湯大全死之。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Lin Shuangwen captured Fengshan; Magistrate Tang Daquan died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Lin Shuangwen took Fengshan and Magistrate Tang Daquan fell.

sentences.zh: 甲申，常青以守備陳邦光督義民守鹿仔港，收復彰化奏聞。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Changqing memorialized that garrison commander Chen Bangguang led militia at Luzai Port, recovered Zhanghua, and reported.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Changqing reported Chen Bangguang's recovery of Zhanghua at Luzai Port.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命王傑為東閣大學士，管禮部事。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Wang Jie was made Associate Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and ordered to manage Rites affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Wang Jie became Eastern Pavilion associate grand secretary over rites.

sentences.zh: 調彭元瑞為兵部尚書，以紀昀為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Peng Yuanrui was transferred to be Minister of War; Ji Yun was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yuanrui took war; Ji Yun, rites.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，允戶部尚書曹文埴終養，以董誥代之。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Minister of Revenue Cao Wenpei's request for retirement to care for parents was granted; Dong Gao was appointed to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Cao Wenpei retired for filial care and Dong Gao took revenue.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命松筠往庫倫辦事。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Song Jin was ordered to go to Kulun on business.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Song Jin was sent to Kulun.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命常青渡台剿匪。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Changqing was ordered to cross to Taiwan to suppress the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Changqing was ordered across the strait to Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，林爽文復陷鳳山，犯台灣府，柴大紀督兵民御之。

translations.literal: Second month, day renyin: Lin Shuangwen again captured Fengshan, attacked Taiwan prefecture; Chai Daji directed troops and people in defense.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, renyin, Lin Shuangwen retook Fengshan, besieged Taiwan city, and Chai Daji led the defense.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以李綬為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Li Shou was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Li Shou became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以長麟為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Changlin was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Changlin took Shandong.

sentences.zh: 壬子，免台灣府屬本年額賦。

translations.literal: On day renzi, this year's quota taxes were remitted for subordinate districts of Taiwan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Taiwan lost this year's quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，復諸羅。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Zhuluo was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Zhuluo was recovered.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上詣東陵。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor went to the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Hongli worshipped at the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor paid rites at Zhao Western Tombs, Xiaoling, Xiao East Tombs, and Jing Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Hongli worshipped at Zhao Western, Xiaoling, Xiao East, and Jing tombs.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，上回蹕。

translations.literal: Third month, day guiyou: the Emperor returned from the progress tour.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, guiyou, Hongli returned from tour.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以重修明陵成，上臨閱，申禁樵採。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, because repair of the Ming tombs was completed, the Emperor went to inspect them and renewed the prohibition on fuel-gathering.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Hongli inspected the restored Ming tombs and banned woodcutting.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，復鳳山。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Fengshan was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Fengshan was recovered.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以姜晟為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Jiang Sheng was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Jiang Sheng took Hubei.

sentences.zh: 黃仕簡以貽誤軍機褫職，令其長孫嘉謨襲公爵。

translations.literal: Huang Shijian was stripped of office for delaying and obstructing military affairs; his eldest grandson Jiamo was ordered to inherit the duke's title.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Shijian was stripped for military delay; Jiamo inherited the dukedom.

sentences.zh: 乙未，逮黃仕簡下獄。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Huang Shijian was arrested and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Huang Shijian was jailed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，以常青為將軍，恆瑞、藍元枚為參贊。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinchou: Chang Qing was made general; Heng Rui and Lan Yuanmei were made campaign staff ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, xinchou, Chang Qing became general and Heng Rui and Lan Yuanmei became campaign staff.

sentences.zh: 調藍元枚為福建水師提督，柴大紀署陸路提督。

translations.literal: Lan Yuanmei was transferred to be Fujian naval commander; Chai Daji acted as Fujian land-route commander.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Yuanmei took the Fujian navy and Chai Daji acted on land.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor went to Heilongtan to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Hongli prayed for rain at Heilongtan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賜史致光等一百三十七人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Shi Zhiguang and one hundred thirty-seven others were granted jinshi graduate status with differing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, 137 graduates including Shi Zhiguang received jinshi rank by degree.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上閱火器營兵。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor reviewed the Firearms Battalion troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Hongli reviewed the Firearms Battalion.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯朔，烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣貢楚克紥布病免，以三丕勒多爾濟代之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day dingmao: Uliasutai expedition minister Guntukezhabu was relieved for illness; Sanpeleduoerji replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth-month new moon, ill Guntukezhabu left Uliasutai and Sanpeleduoerji replaced him.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，授蘭第錫河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Landisi was appointed eastern-route Grand Canal governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Landisi became eastern-route canal governor.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Emperor set out on the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Hongli left for the Mulan autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Escaping Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Hongli reached the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 湖南鳳凰廳苗作亂，總兵尹德禧討平之。

translations.literal: Miao at Fenghuang subprefecture in Hunan rebelled; regional commander Yin Dexi suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan Fenghuang Miao rebelled and Yin Dexi put them down.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，免浙江仁和場潮沖盪地額課。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengxu: quota taxes were remitted for tide-scoured land at Renhe field in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, gengxu, Zhejiang Renhe tide land lost quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 壬子，授柴大紀福建陸路提督，兼管台灣總兵事。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Chai Daji was made Fujian land-route commander, concurrently managing Taiwan garrison commander affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Chai Daji took Fujian land forces and Taiwan garrison affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，召福康安赴行在，以勒保署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Fukang'an was summoned to the imperial camp; Lebao was ordered to act as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Fukang'an was recalled and Lebao acted as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，以海蘭察為參贊大臣，舒亮、普爾普為領隊大臣，率侍衛、章京等赴台灣剿賊。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renchen: Hai Lancha was made campaign staff minister; Shu Liang and Pu'erpu were made lead commanders, leading guards and clerks to Taiwan to suppress rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, renchen, Hai Lancha became campaign staff and Shu Liang and Pu'erpu led guards to Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賑安徽懷遠、鳳陽等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day guisi, relief was given for flood disaster in Anhui prefectures and counties including Huaiyuan and Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Huaiyuan, Fengyang, and other Anhui flood districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 賑山西豐鎮等九廳州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for drought disaster in nine Shanxi prefectures, departments, and counties including Fengzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Shanxi drought districts including Fengzhen received relief.

sentences.zh: 八月，常青免，命福康安為將軍，赴台灣督辦軍務。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Chang Qing was dismissed; Fukang'an was ordered to serve as general and go to Taiwan to supervise military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, Chang Qing was dismissed and Fukang'an took Taiwan command.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor went to Mulan for the enclosure hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Hongli hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renshen: the Emperor returned to halt at the Mountain Resort for Escaping Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, renshen, Hongli returned to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上回蹕。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor returned on his southern progress.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Hongli returned south in progress.

sentences.zh: 壬午，調柴大紀為福建水師提督，以蔡攀龍為福建陸路提督，並授參贊。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Chai Daji was transferred to be Fujian naval commander; Cai Panlong was made Fujian land-route commander and also granted campaign staff rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Chai Daji took the Fujian navy and Cai Panlong took land forces with campaign staff rank.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以諸羅仍未解圍，催福康安徑剿大里杙賊，並分兵進大甲溪。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, because Zhuluo was still under siege, Fukang'an was urged to strike directly at rebel Dalikuo and also to divide troops to advance up the Dajia River.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, with Zhuluo still besieged, Fukang'an was told to hit Dalikuo and send a column up the Dajia River.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，命福長安署工部尚書。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingwei: Fu Chang'an was ordered to act as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth-month dingwei, Fu Chang'an acted as works minister.

sentences.zh: 戊申，修福陵。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Fu Mausoleum was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Fu Mausoleum was repaired.

sentences.zh: 丁未，睢州下汛決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the breach at the lower flood segment of Suizhou was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Suizhou lower breach was closed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命阿桂赴江南勘高堰等處堤工。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Agui was ordered to go to Jiangnan to survey dikes at Gaoyan and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Agui was sent to survey Jiangnan dikes at Gaoyan and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 戊午，免江蘇清河等二十三州縣及淮安等五衛本年水災漕項漕米有差。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, this year's grain-transport rice and levies were remitted for twenty-three Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Qinghe and five guards including Huai'an for flood disaster, with differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, twenty-three Jiangsu counties and five Huai'an guards lost this year's transport grain levies from flood, by degree.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以福州將軍恆瑞剿賊怯懦，召來京，調鄂輝代之。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, because Fuzhou general Heng Rui had been timid in suppressing rebels, he was summoned to the capital and E Hui replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, timid Heng Rui was recalled and E Hui became Fuzhou general.

sentences.zh: 賑直隸保安等七州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for drought disaster in seven Zhili prefectures and counties including Bao'an.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Zhili drought counties including Bao'an were relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命江蘇、浙江撥濟福建軍需錢各五萬貫。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Jiangsu and Zhejiang were each ordered to allocate fifty thousand strings of cash to supply Fujian military needs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Jiangsu and Zhejiang each sent fifty thousand strings for Fujian supplies.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子朔，加李侍堯、孫士毅太子太保，柴大紀太子少保。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day jiazi: Li Shiyao and Sun Shiyi were raised to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent; Chai Daji to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh-month new moon, Li Shiyao and Sun Shiyi became grand guardians and Chai Daji junior guardian.

sentences.zh: 賜台灣廣東庄、泉州庄義民御書扁額。

translations.literal: Imperial calligraphy plaques were granted to the Guangdong and Quanzhou loyalist villages in Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan's Guangdong and Quanzhou loyalist villages received imperial plaques.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以柴大紀固守嘉義，封一等義勇伯，世襲。

translations.literal: On day renshen, because Chai Daji had held firm at Chiayi, he was enfeoffed as a first-class Baron of Righteous Courage, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Chai Daji became a hereditary first-class Baron of Righteous Courage for holding Chiayi.

sentences.zh: 免台灣嘉義縣五十四年額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes for the fifty-fourth year were remitted for Chiayi county in Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: Chiayi in Taiwan lost its year-54 quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 以巴延三奏達賴喇嘛遣使稱「夷使」，申飭之。

translations.literal: Bayansan was admonished for memorializing that the Dalai Lama had sent envoys he called "barbarian envoys."
translations.idiomatic: Bayansan was rebuked for calling the Dalai Lama's envoys "barbarian envoys."

sentences.zh: 乙酉，奎林以婪贓，褫職逮問，以保寧為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Kui Lin was stripped of office and arrested for greed; Baoning was made Yili general.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, greedy Kui Lin was arrested and Baoning became Yili general.

sentences.zh: 調李世傑為四川總督，以書麟為兩江總督，陳用敷為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Li Shijie was transferred to be Sichuan governor-general; Shu Lin was made Liangjiang governor-general; Chen Yongfu was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shijie took Sichuan; Shu Lin, Liangjiang; Chen Yongfu, Anhui.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，福康安等敗賊於侖仔頂庄等處，解嘉義圍，晉封福康安、海蘭察公爵，各賞紅寶石頂、四團龍補褂。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingwei: Fukang'an and others defeated rebels at Lunzaiding village and elsewhere, lifted the siege of Chiayi, and Fukang'an and Hai Lancha were advanced to dukes, each granted a ruby finial and a four-round-dragon rank robe.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, dingwei, Fukang'an broke rebels at Lunzaiding, relieved Chiayi, and he and Hai Lancha became dukes with ruby finials and four-dragon robes.

sentences.zh: 己酉，遷常青福州將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Chang Qing was transferred to be Fuzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Chang Qing became Fuzhou general.

sentences.zh: 以舒常為湖廣總督，福長安為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Shu Chang was made Huguang governor-general; Fu Chang'an was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Chang took Huguang and Fu Chang'an took works.

sentences.zh: 以福康安劾柴大紀、蔡攀龍戰守之功多不確實，諭：「柴大紀堅持定見，竭力固守。

translations.literal: Because Fukang'an had impeached Chai Daji and Cai Panlong for overstating their battle merits, an edict stated: "Chai Daji held to his decision and strove to defend.
translations.idiomatic: After Fukang'an attacked Chai Daji and Cai Panlong for inflated merit, Hongli ruled: "Chai Daji held firm and defended to the limit.

sentences.zh: 蔡攀龍奮勇殺賊，竟抵縣城。

translations.literal: Cai Panlong fought bravely, killing rebels, and actually reached the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Panlong fought hard, killed rebels, and reached the county seat.

sentences.zh: 或在福康安前禮節不謹，致為所憎。

translations.literal: Perhaps they were not careful in etiquette before Fukang'an, causing his dislike.
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps they offended Fukang'an in etiquette and he turned against them.

sentences.zh: 豈可轉沒其功，遽加無名之罪？

translations.literal: How can their merits be erased and groundless charges rushed upon them?"
translations.idiomatic: How can merit be denied and baseless charges piled on?"

sentences.zh: 」以孫士毅調兵運械，不分畛域，賞雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: Because Sun Shiyi had moved troops and transported weapons without regard to administrative boundaries, double-eyed peacock feathers were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi was granted double peacock feathers for moving troops and supplies across boundaries.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以德成奏稱柴大紀貪縱廢弛，命福康安、李侍堯據實參奏，並以喀什噶爾辦事大臣雅德在福建時徇隱，逮之。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, because Decheng had reported Chai Daji's greed and dereliction, Fukang'an and Li Shiyao were ordered to impeach on the facts; Yade, Kashgar affairs minister, was arrested for having covered for him when he was in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Decheng's charge of Chai Daji's greed sent Fukang'an and Li Shiyao to impeach on facts and Yade was arrested for Fujian cover-up.

sentences.zh: 庚申，伍拉納護福建巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Wulana was ordered to act as Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wulana acted as Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 以永鐸為盛京將軍，尚安為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: Yongduo was made Mukden general; Shang'an was made Urumqi military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yongduo became Mukden general and Shang'an, Urumqi governor.

sentences.zh: 五十三年春正月丁卯，免兵差經過之福建晉江等二十縣本年額賦有差。

translations.literal: Fifty-third year, spring, first month, day dingmao: this year's quota taxes were remitted for twenty Fujian counties including Jinjiang through which troops had passed, with differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In year 53, month 1, dingmao, twenty Fujian troop-route counties including Jinjiang lost this year's taxes, by degree.

sentences.zh: 辛未，明興奏山西永寧等處河清。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Ming Xing memorialized that the river had cleared at Yongning and elsewhere in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Ming Xing reported the river clear at Shanxi Yongning and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，柴大紀褫職逮問。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Chai Daji was stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Chai Daji was stripped and arrested.

sentences.zh: 福州將軍常青以徇隱柴大紀褫職。

translations.literal: Fuzhou general Chang Qing was stripped of office for covering for Chai Daji.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Qing lost Fuzhou for covering Chai Daji.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午朔，獲林爽文，賞福康安、海蘭察御用佩囊，議敘將弁有差。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day jiawu: Lin Shuangwen was captured; Fukang'an and Hai Lancha were granted imperial pouches; officers were rewarded by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On the second-month new moon, Lin Shuangwen was taken; Fukang'an and Hai Lancha got imperial pouches and officers were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 晉封大學士和珅三等伯爵。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Heshen was advanced to third-class earl.
translations.idiomatic: Heshen was raised to a third-class earl.

sentences.zh: 大學士阿桂、王傑，尚書福長安、董誥議敘。

translations.literal: Grand Secretaries Agui and Wang Jie and Ministers Fu Chang'an and Dong Gao were entered for merit registers.
translations.idiomatic: Agui, Wang Jie, Fu Chang'an, and Dong Gao received merit registers.

sentences.zh: 予孫士毅輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: Sun Shiyi was granted a hereditary Commandant of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi received a hereditary chariot commandancy.

sentences.zh: 乙未，釋黃仕簡、任承恩。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Huang Shijian and Ren Chengen were released.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Huang Shijian and Ren Chengen were freed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，伊犁參贊大臣海祿以劾奎林失實褫職，與奎林俱罰在拜唐阿上效力。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Yili expedition minister Hailu was stripped of office for a false impeachment of Kui Lin; both were punished to serve as bondsmen.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Hailu lost Yili for false charges against Kui Lin and both served as bondsmen.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，立先賢有子後裔五經博士。

translations.literal: On day yisi, a Five Classics Erudite was established for the descendant of the ancient sage Youzi.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Youzi's line received a Five Classics erudite.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上巡幸天津。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor made a progress tour to Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Hongli toured Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 庚申，獲台灣賊首庄大田，議敘提督許世亨等有差。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Taiwan rebel chief Zhuang Datian was captured; regional commander Xu Shiheng and others were rewarded by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Zhuang Datian was taken and Xu Shiheng and other officers were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，免天津府屬逋賦。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, tax arrears in Tianjin prefecture were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Tianjin tax arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上御閱武樓閱兵。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor reviewed troops at the Military Review Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Hongli reviewed troops at the Review Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，命侍郎穆精阿赴湖北，會同舒常查案。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuchen: Vice Minister Mu Jing'a was ordered to go to Hubei to join Shu Chang in investigating a case.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, wuchen, Mu Jing'a was sent to Hubei with Shu Chang to investigate.

sentences.zh: 壬申，林爽文伏誅。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Lin Shuangwen was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Lin Shuangwen was executed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，再賞福康安、海蘭察紫韁、金黃辮珊瑚朝珠及福康安金黃腰帶。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Fukang'an and Hai Lancha were again granted purple reins, golden-braided coral court beads, and Fukang'an a golden yellow belt.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Fukang'an and Hai Lancha again received purple reins, coral beads, and Fukang'an a golden yellow belt.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，以旱命刑部減徒以下罪。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinchou: because of drought, the Ministry of Punishments reduced sentences for penal servitude and below.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, xinchou, drought brought reduced sentences below penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor reviewed the Vanguard Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Hongli reviewed the Vanguard Camp.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，免江蘇清河等十八州縣、淮安等五衛上年水災額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, last year's quota taxes were remitted for eighteen Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Qinghe and five guards including Huai'an for flood disaster, with differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, eighteen Jiangsu counties and five Huai'an guards lost last year's flood taxes, by degree.

sentences.zh: 己未，富勒渾、雅德以失察柴大紀論絞。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Fulehun and Yade were sentenced to strangulation for failing to supervise Chai Daji.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Fulehun and Yade were condemned to strangulation for lax oversight of Chai Daji.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，蠲河南商丘等六州縣上年水災額賦有差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingmao: last year's quota taxes were remitted for six Henan prefectures and counties including Shangqiu for flood disaster, with differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, dingmao, six Henan flood counties including Shangqiu lost last year's taxes, by degree.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，蠲直隸保安等七州縣上年水災民田旗地額賦。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, last year's quota taxes on civilian and banner land were remitted for seven Zhili prefectures and counties including Bao'an for flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, seven Zhili flood counties including Bao'an lost last year's civilian and banner land taxes.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor set out on the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Hongli left for the Mulan autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 癸未，宥常青罪。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Chang Qing's crimes were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Chang Qing was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賑台灣難民。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, relief was given to refugees in Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Taiwan refugees were relieved.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，富綱奏緬甸孟隕差頭目業渺瑞洞等齎金葉表文進貢，諭護送迅來行在。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingshen: Fugang memorialized that Burma's Mengyun had sent envoys including Yemiaoruidong bearing gold-leaf memorials as tribute; an order instructed that they be escorted quickly to the imperial camp.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, bingshen, Fugang reported Burmese tribute envoys and Hongli ordered them rushed to camp.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賑湖南漵浦縣水災。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, relief was given for flood disaster in Xupu county, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Xupu in Hunan received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 免安徽鳳陽等四府州衛上年水災額賦有差。

translations.literal: Last year's quota taxes were remitted for four Anhui prefectures, departments, and guards including Fengyang for flood disaster, with differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Four Anhui districts including Fengyang lost last year's flood taxes, by degree.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賑湖北長陽縣水災。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, relief was given for flood disaster in Changyang county, Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Changyang in Hubei received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免陝西華州等三州縣五十一年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, quota taxes for the fifty-first year were remitted for three Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Huazhou for flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, three Shaanxi counties including Huazhou lost year-51 flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 戊申，安南人阮惠等叛逐其國王黎維祁，維祁來求援。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Annamese Nguyễn Huệ and others rebelled and expelled their king Lê Duy Kỳ; Kỳ came seeking aid.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Nguyễn Huệ expelled King Lê Duy Kỳ, who fled to seek aid.

sentences.zh: 命孫士毅赴廣西撫諭之。

translations.literal: Sun Shiyi was ordered to go to Guangxi to soothe and instruct.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi was sent to Guangxi to reassure them.

sentences.zh: 免山西大同等九州縣上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Last year's quota taxes were remitted for nine Shanxi prefectures and counties including Datong for drought disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Shanxi drought counties including Datong lost last year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉朔，以安南牧馬官阮輝宿奉黎維祁之母及子來奔，諭孫士毅等撫恤之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, new moon on day xinyou: because the Annam horse official Nguyễn Huy Tú had brought Lê Duy Kỳ's mother and son as refugees, Sun Shiyi and others were instructed to comfort and support them.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh-month new moon, Nguyễn Huy Tú brought Lê Duy Kỳ's kin and Sun Shiyi was told to care for them.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賑山東膠州、壽光水災。

translations.literal: On day renxu, relief was given for flood disaster in Jiaozhou and Shouguang in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Jiaozhou and Shouguang in Shandong received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 湖北荊州江溢，府城及滿城均浸沒，諭舒常等查勘撫恤。

translations.literal: The Yangtze overflowed at Jingzhou in Hubei; both the prefectural city and the Manchu city were inundated; Shu Chang and others were instructed to survey and relieve.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou's Yangtze flood drowned both cities and Shu Chang was told to survey and relieve.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賞還閩浙總督李侍堯伯爵，予現襲之李奉堯提督銜。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Li Shiyao's earldom was restored; his heir Li Fengyao was granted regional commander rank on present inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Li Shiyao regained his earldom and heir Li Fengyao received regional commander rank.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，湖北武昌、漢陽江溢。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Yangtze overflowed at Wuchang and Hanyang in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Yangtze flooded Wuchang and Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 以畢沅為湖廣總督，伍拉納為河南巡撫，明興為烏什辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Bi Yuan was made Huguang governor-general; Wulana was made Henan governor; Ming Xing was made Ushi affairs minister.
translations.idiomatic: Bi Yuan took Huguang; Wulana, Henan; Ming Xing, Ushi.

sentences.zh: 賑安徽懷寧等州縣水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for flood disaster in Anhui prefectures and counties including Huaining.
translations.idiomatic: Huaining and other Anhui flood districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 柴大紀處斬。

translations.literal: Chai Daji was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Chai Daji was executed.

sentences.zh: 召姜晟來京，以惠齡為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Jiang Sheng was summoned to the capital; Huiling was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Sheng was recalled and Huiling became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，廓爾喀據後藏濟嚨、聶拉木，命成德與穆克登阿剿之。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Gurkhas occupied Gyirong and Nyalam in rear Tibet; Chengde and Mukedeng'a were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Gurkhas took Gyirong and Nyalam and Chengde and Mukedeng'a were sent to fight them.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，賑湖北監利、石首水災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiachen: relief was given for flood disaster in Jianli and Shishou in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, jiachen, Jianli and Shishou in Hubei received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor went to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Hongli went to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以木蘭大水，停行圍。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, because of great flooding at Mulan, the enclosure hunt was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Mulan flooding stopped the enclosure hunt.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，廓爾喀復陷宗喀，以鄂輝為將軍、成德為參贊大臣剿之。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Gurkhas again took Dzongkha; E Hui was made general and Chengde campaign staff minister to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Gurkhas retook Dzongkha and E Hui became general with Chengde as campaign staff.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，安南阮岳等遁，命孫士毅督許世亨進剿，命富綱統兵進駐蒙自。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Nguyễn Huệ and others fled; Sun Shiyi was ordered to supervise Xu Shiheng's advance against them; Fugang was ordered to command troops stationed at Mengzi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Nguyễn Huệ fled; Sun Shiyi directed Xu Shiheng's advance and Fugang garrisoned Mengzi.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor returned to halt at the Mountain Resort for Escaping Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Hongli returned to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，緬甸番目細哈覺控等入覲，諭暹羅、緬甸現均內附，二國應修好，不得仍前構兵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renxu: Burmese chiefs including Xihajuekong had an audience; an order stated that Siam and Burma were now both submitted and the two countries should keep peace and not resume former hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, renxu, Burmese chiefs had audience and Hongli told Siam and Burma to keep peace now that both had submitted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，賑湖北沔陽、黃岡水災。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, relief was given for flood disaster in Mianyang and Huanggang in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Mianyang and Huanggang in Hubei received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，免安徽宿州等二十一州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, quota taxes for last year's flood disaster were remitted for twenty-one Anhui prefectures, counties, guards, and posts including Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, twenty-one Anhui districts including Suzhou lost last year's flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，廓爾喀侵後藏薩喀。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengyin: Gurkhas invaded Sakya in rear Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, gengyin, Gurkhas invaded Sakya in rear Tibet.

sentences.zh: 命孫士毅出關督剿。

translations.literal: Sun Shiyi was ordered to leave the passes and supervise suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi was sent beyond the passes to command suppression.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賑湖北潛江水災。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, relief was given for flood disaster in Qianjiang, Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Qianjiang in Hubei received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賑湖北江夏等三十六州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, relief was given for flood disaster in thirty-six Hubei prefectures and counties including Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, thirty-six Hubei districts including Jiangxia received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以黎維祁闇弱，諭孫士毅選擇黎裔入京朝貢。

translations.literal: On day jihai, because Lê Duy Kỳ was weak and feeble, Sun Shiyi was instructed to select a Lê descendant to come to the capital to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Sun Shiyi was told to choose a Lê heir for Beijing tribute because Lê Duy Kỳ was feeble.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命雲南提督烏大經統兵出關，檄諭阮惠等來歸。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Yunnan provincial commander Wuda Jing was ordered to lead troops beyond the passes and send a proclamation summoning Nguyễn Huệ and others to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wuda Jing marched out with a summons for Nguyễn Huệ to surrender.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，調舒濂為駐藏大臣，以恆瑞為伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Shu Lian was transferred to be resident commissioner in Tibet and Heng Rui was made Ili assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Shu Lian took Tibet and Heng Rui, Ili.

sentences.zh: 調都爾嘉為盛京將軍，恆秀為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: Dorjia was transferred to be Mukden general; Hengxiu was made Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: Dorjia became Mukden general and Hengxiu, Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 改嵩椿為西安將軍，以興兆代之。

translations.literal: Songchun was changed to Xi'an general, with Xingzhao replacing him.
translations.idiomatic: Songchun became Xi'an general and Xingzhao replaced him.

sentences.zh: 琳寧為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Linning was made Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: Linning became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，李侍堯病，命福康安署閩浙總督。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Li Shiyao fell ill and Fukang'an was ordered to act as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, ill Li Shiyao left Fukang'an acting as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，免安徽望江等二十六州縣衛本年被水額賦有差。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinyou: this year's flood quota taxes were remitted with differing amounts for twenty-six Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Wangjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, xinyou, twenty-six Anhui districts including Wangjiang lost this year's flood taxes, by degree.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，李侍堯卒，以福康安代之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Li Shiyao died and Fukang'an replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Li Shiyao died and Fukang'an succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 以勒保為陝甘總督，海寧為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Lebao was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general and Haining was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Lebao took Shaanxi-Gansu and Haining, Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 丙子，修湖北江陵、公安各堤。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, dikes at Jiangling and Gong'an in Hubei were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Hubei dikes at Jiangling and Gong'an were repaired.

sentences.zh: 免湖北江陵等三十六州縣本年水災額賦有差。

translations.literal: This year's flood quota taxes were remitted with differing amounts for thirty-six Hubei prefectures and counties including Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-six Hubei districts including Jiangling lost this year's flood taxes, by degree.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，釋富勒渾、雅德。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jichou: Fulehun and Yade were released.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jichou, Fulehun and Yade were freed.

sentences.zh: 孫士毅奏敗賊於壽昌江。

translations.literal: Sun Shiyi memorialized defeating rebels on the Shouchang River.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi reported victory on the Shouchang River.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，又敗賊於市球江。

translations.literal: On day guisi, rebels were again defeated on the Shiqiu River.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, rebels were beaten again at Shiqiu River.

sentences.zh: 丙申，收復黎城，復封黎維祁安南國王，封孫士毅為一等謀勇公，許世亨為一等子。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Licheng was recovered; Lê Duy Kỳ was re-enfeoffed as king of Annam; Sun Shiyi was enfeoffed as a first-class Duke of Sincere Planning and Brave Merit; Xu Shiheng was made a first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Licheng was taken, Lê Duy Kỳ restored as Annam king, Sun Shiyi made a first-class duke, and Xu Shiheng a first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命孫士毅班師。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Sun Shiyi was ordered to withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Sun Shiyi was ordered to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 五十四年春正月己未，以元旦受賀，朝班不肅，褫糾儀御史等職，尚書德保摘翎頂，都察院、鴻臚寺堂官均下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Fifty-fourth year, spring, first month, day jiwei: because the New Year audience was disorderly, the supervisory censor of the rites and others were stripped of office; Minister Debao had his plume and cap removed; the presidents of the Censorate and Court of State Ceremonial were all severely censured at the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In year 54 spring, jiwei New Year, rites disorder cost censors their posts, Debao his insignia, and Censorate and Honglu chiefs a severe board hearing.

sentences.zh: 庚申，成德以收復宗喀、濟嚨，克聶拉木奏聞。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Cheng De memorialized recovery of Dzongkha and Gyirong and capture of Nyalam.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Cheng De reported recovery of Dzongkha, Gyirong, and Nyalam.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，禮部尚書德保卒，以常青代之。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Minister of Rites Debao died and Chang Qing replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Debao died and Chang Qing took rites.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以緬甸孟隕悔罪投誠，諭令睦鄰修好，並賜暹羅國王鄭華糹采幣，令其解仇消釁。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, because Burma's Meng Yun had repented and submitted, he was instructed to live at peace with neighbors, and King Zheng Hua of Siam was given silks and told to end enmity and strife.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, repentant Burma was told to keep peace and Siam's Zheng Hua was bribed to end feuds.

sentences.zh: 免福建淡水等六廳縣災欠額賦。

translations.literal: Arrears of quota taxes were remitted for six Fujian prefectures and counties including Danshui on account of disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Six Fujian districts including Danshui lost disaster tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 癸未，阮惠復陷黎城，廣西提督許世亨等死之。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Nguyễn Huệ again seized Licheng and Guangxi provincial commander Xu Shiheng and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Nguyễn Huệ retook Licheng and Xu Shiheng and other Guangxi commanders fell.

sentences.zh: 召孫士毅來京，削公爵。

translations.literal: Sun Shiyi was summoned to the capital and stripped of his ducal rank.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi was called to Beijing and lost his dukedom.

sentences.zh: 調福康安為兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Fukang'an was transferred to be Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an became Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以伍拉納為閩浙總督，梁肯堂為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Wulana was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Liang Kentang was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wulana took Fujian-Zhejiang and Liang Kentang, Henan.

sentences.zh: 以海祿為廣西提督。

translations.literal: Hailu was made Guangxi provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: Hailu became Guangxi commander.

sentences.zh: 甲申，安南國王黎維祁復來奔，命安插廣西。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the king of Annam, Lê Duy Kỳ, again fled to refuge; he was ordered settled in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Lê Duy Kỳ fled again and was settled in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，褫孫士毅職，命仍以總督頂戴在鎮南關辦事。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Sun Shiyi was stripped of office but ordered still to wear a governor's insignia and handle affairs at Zhennan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Sun Shiyi lost office but kept governor rank at Zhennan Pass.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，以京察屆期，予大學士阿桂等議敘，內閣學士謝墉等下部議處，理藩院侍郎福祿原品休致，予總督福康安等議敘。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengyin: because the capital evaluation period had come, Agui and other grand secretaries were given performance reviews; Secretariat academician Xie Yong and others were censured at the Board of Punishments; Lifanyuan vice president Fulu retired at his original rank; Fukang'an and other governors-general were given evaluations.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2 gengyin, Agui and others were reviewed, Xie Yong censured, Fulu retired, and Fukang'an reviewed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，勒保陛見，以巴延三署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Lebao had audience and Bayansan acted as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Lebao had audience and Bayansan acted at Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 和闐領隊大臣格繃額以婪索鞫實，處斬。

translations.literal: Gebeng'e, leading officer in Khotan, was found guilty on investigation of extortion and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Khotan officer Gebeng'e was executed for proven extortion.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，調蘭第錫為江南河道總督，李奉翰為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Landisi was transferred to be Jiangnan canal transport governor-general and Li Fenggan was made Hedong canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Landisi took Jiangnan canals and Li Fenggan, Hedong.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以安南瘴癘炎荒，不值用兵，詳諭福康安。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Fukang'an was instructed in detail that Annam's miasma and harsh land were not worth military action.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Fukang'an was told Annam was too feverish and poor for war.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，免甘肅積年逋賦及未完籽種口糧。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi: accumulated Gansu tax arrears and unpaid seed grain and rations were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 jiazi, Gansu arrears, seed, and rations were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 免陝西延安等三府州未完倉穀。

translations.literal: Unpaid stored grain in three Yan'an prefectures and departments in Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Three Yan'an districts lost unpaid store grain.

sentences.zh: 諭福康安檄阮惠縛獻戕害提鎮之匪。

translations.literal: Fukang'an was instructed to demand by proclamation that Nguyễn Huệ bind and deliver the rebels who had killed provincial commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an was told to demand Nguyễn Huệ hand over those who killed commanders.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，劉墉以上書房師傅曠職，降侍郎銜。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Liu Yong was demoted to vice-minister rank for absenteeism as tutor in the Upper Study Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, absent tutor Liu Yong was demoted to vice-minister.

sentences.zh: 以彭元瑞為吏部尚書，孫士毅為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Peng Yuanrui was made Minister of Personnel and Sun Shiyi Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yuanrui took personnel and Sun Shiyi, war.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上幸盤山。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor went to Mount Pan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Hongli went to Mount Pan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，免奉天廣寧、鳳凰二城屬上年水災額賦，仍賑恤有差。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi: quota taxes from last year's flood in two cities under Guangning and Fenghuang in Fengtian were remitted, with differentiated relief continued.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 wuzi, Fengtian Guangning and Fenghuang lost last year's flood taxes and relief continued, by degree.

sentences.zh: 丙申，晉贈許世亨伯爵，令其子承謨襲。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Xu Shiheng was posthumously raised to a baron and his son Chengmou was ordered to inherit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Xu Shiheng was made a posthumous baron for Chengmou to inherit.

sentences.zh: 召孫士毅回京。

translations.literal: Sun Shiyi was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以恆瑞為烏里雅蘇台將軍，福長安署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Heng Rui was made Uliasutai general and Fukang'an acting Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Heng Rui took Uliasutai and Fukang'an acted at war.

sentences.zh: 諭福康安安插安南黎氏宗族舊臣。

translations.literal: Fukang'an was instructed to settle the old clansmen and former ministers of the Lê house in Annam.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an was told to settle Annam's Lê clansmen and old ministers.

sentences.zh: 予從軍出力之諒山都督潘啟德以都司用。

translations.literal: Pan Qide, Lang Son prefect who had served in the campaign, was granted use at the rank of regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Campaign veteran Pan Qide of Lang Son was made a regional commander.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命阿桂覆勘荊州堤工。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Agui was ordered to re-inspect Jingzhou dike works.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Agui re-inspected Jingzhou dikes.

sentences.zh: 丁未，宣諭：「安南水土惡劣，決計不復用兵。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, an imperial proclamation stated: "Annam's waters and soil are vile; the decision is firmly not to use troops again.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Hongli proclaimed Annam too foul to fight again.

sentences.zh: 阮惠已三次乞降，果赴闕求恩，可量加封號。

translations.literal: Nguyễn Huệ has already begged surrender three times; if he truly comes to court to beg grace, a title may be granted in measure.
translations.idiomatic: If Nguyễn Huệ truly came to court, he might receive a measured title.

sentences.zh: 朕撫馭外夷，無不體上天好生之德，從未敢窮兵黷武。

translations.literal: In cherishing outer barbarians, I never fail to embody Heaven's virtue of cherishing life and have never dared to exhaust the state in war.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli claimed he cherished life and never exhausted the state in war.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，賜胡長齡等九十八人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: " On day xinhai, Hu Changling and ninety-eight others were granted jinshi graduate status with differing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, ninety-eight graduates including Hu Changling received jinshi rank by degree.

sentences.zh: 調都爾嘉為黑龍江將軍，嵩椿為盛京將軍，恆秀為綏遠城將軍，琳寧為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: Dorjia was transferred to be Heilongjiang general; Songchun to Mukden general; Hengxiu to Suiyuan city general; Linning to Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: Dorjia took Heilongjiang, Songchun Mukden, Hengxiu Suiyuan, and Linning Jilin.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以阮惠不親來吁懇，遣阮光顯入關進貢，諭福康安卻之。

translations.literal: On day guichou, because Nguyễn Huệ did not come in person to plead, Nguyễn Quang Hiển was sent through the pass to offer tribute; Fukang'an was instructed to refuse him.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Nguyễn Quang Hiển's tribute was refused because Nguyễn Huệ would not come himself.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，豁直隸宣化等四縣上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, quota taxes for last year's drought in four Zhili counties including Xuanhua were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, four Zhili drought counties including Xuanhua lost last year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，免官兵經過之廣西柳州等五府屬本年額賦。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiwei: this year's quota taxes were remitted for five Guangxi prefectures under Liuzhou through which troops had passed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 jiwei, five Guangxi Liuzhou districts lost this year's taxes for troop passage.

sentences.zh: 福康安等奏安南阮惠遣其侄阮光顯賚表貢乞降，並吁懇入覲。

translations.literal: Fukang'an and others memorialized that Nguyễn Huệ had sent his nephew Nguyễn Quang Hiển bearing a memorial and tribute begging surrender and also pleading to have audience.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an reported Nguyễn Huệ sent nephew Nguyễn Quang Hiển with tribute and a plea for audience.

sentences.zh: 許之，卻其貢。

translations.literal: This was granted, but the tribute was refused.
translations.idiomatic: Audience was allowed but tribute refused.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，增伊犁惠遠城、惠寧城官。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, official posts at Huizhou and Huining cities in Ili were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Ili's Huizhou and Huining gained more officials.

sentences.zh: 閏五月庚寅，上秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, day gengyin: the Emperor went for the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On intercalary month 5 gengyin, Hongli hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，免奉天廣寧等七城上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, quota taxes from last year's flood in seven Fengtian cities including Guangning were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, seven Fengtian districts including Guangning lost last year's flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賑雲南通海等五州縣地震災民。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, victims of earthquake in five Yunnan prefectures and counties including Tonghai were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, five Yunnan districts including Tonghai received earthquake relief.

sentences.zh: 六月，免安徽安慶等七府州五十三年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month: fifty-third-year flood quota taxes were remitted for seven Anhui prefectures and departments including Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, seven Anhui districts including Anqing lost year-53 flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以管幹貞為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Guan Ganzhen was made Grand Canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Guan Ganzhen became canal transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，賑直隸蠡縣水災。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, flood victims in Li County, Zhili, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Zhili's Li County received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命兵部尚書孫士毅軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Minister of War Sun Shiyi was ordered to walk attendance at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Sun Shiyi joined Grand Council walking attendance.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以郭世勛為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Guo Shixun was made Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Guo Shixun became Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以陳步瀛為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Chen Buyuan was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Chen Buyuan became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，福康安奏，阮惠即阮光平，因赦其前罪，准令降附，具表謝恩進貢，並求於明年到京祝釐。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Fukang'an memorialized that Nguyễn Huệ was Nguyễn Quang Bình; because his former crimes were pardoned, surrender was approved, he presented a memorial thanking for grace and offering tribute, and asked to come to the capital next year for the birthday celebration.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Fukang'an said Nguyễn Huệ was Nguyễn Quang Bình, pardoned and allowed to surrender and attend next year's birthday rites.

sentences.zh: 上以其情詞肫切，冊封為安南國王，並賜敕諭。

translations.literal: Because his words were earnest, he was enfeoffed king of Annam and an imperial patent was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Earnest pleading won him the Annam kingship and an imperial patent.

sentences.zh: 免湖北江夏等二十四州縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Last year's flood quota taxes were remitted for twenty-four Hubei prefectures and counties including Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four Hubei districts including Jiangxia lost last year's flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉朔，以決河下注泗州一帶，諭賑恤災民。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, new moon on day yiyou: because the Yellow River breach sent water down into the Suzhou area, disaster victims were instructed to be relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh-month new moon, Suzhou flood victims were told to be relieved after the breach.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賑直隸安州等八州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, flood victims in eight Zhili prefectures and counties including Anzhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, eight Zhili districts including Anzhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 庚子，戶部尚書綽克托卒。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Minister of Revenue Chuoketuo died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Revenue Minister Chuoketuo died.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以巴延三為戶部尚書，秦承恩為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Bayansan was made Minister of Revenue and Qin Chengen was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Bayansan took revenue and Qin Chengen, Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 戊申，安南貢使阮光顯等入覲。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Annam tribute envoys including Nguyễn Quang Hiển had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Nguyễn Quang Hiển and other Annam envoys were received.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，賑河南永城、臨漳等縣水災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yichou: flood victims in Yongcheng and Linzhang and other counties in Henan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 yichou, Henan flood victims in Yongcheng and Linzhang were relieved.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，賑安徽宿州水災。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, flood victims in Anhui's Suzhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Anhui's Suzhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor went to Mulan for the autumn hunt encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Hongli encamped at Mulan for the hunt.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賑直隸清苑等三十四州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, flood victims in thirty-four Zhili prefectures and counties including Qingyuan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, thirty-four Zhili districts including Qingyuan were relieved.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，廓爾喀貢使入覲，封拉特納巴都爾王爵，巴都爾薩野公爵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jichou: Gurkha tribute envoys had audience; Ratna Bahadur was enfeoffed king and Bahadur Shah duke.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9 jichou, Gurkha envoys were received and Ratna Bahadur made king and Bahadur Shah duke.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor returned to lodge at the Mountain Resort for Escaping Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Hongli returned to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賑江蘇銅山等十一州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, flood victims in eleven Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Tongshan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, eleven Jiangsu districts including Tongshan were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賑吉林屬琿春水災，豁應交義倉糧石及上年借給倉穀。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, flood victims in Jilin dependency of Huichun were relieved; due righteousness-store grain and last year's borrowed store grain were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Huichun flood victims were relieved and store grain and last year's loans forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上回蹕。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Emperor returned from the imperial progress.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Hongli returned from progress.

sentences.zh: 丙午，安南黎維祁自保樂襲牧馬，為阮光平所敗。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Annam's Lê Duy Kỳ, from among himself raising horses at Baole, was defeated by Nguyễn Quang Bình.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Lê Duy Kỳ herding horses at Baole was beaten by Nguyễn Quang Bình.

sentences.zh: 諭福康安，如黎維祁來奔，收納之。

translations.literal: Fukang'an was instructed that if Lê Duy Kỳ came fleeing, he should be received.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an was told to receive Lê Duy Kỳ if he fled.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，左都御史阿揚阿卒，以舒常代之。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Left Censor-in-Chief Ayang'a died and Shuchang replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Ayang'a died and Shuchang took the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，察哈爾都統烏爾圖納遜罷，以保泰代之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guichou: Chahar commander general Wulitunasson was dismissed and Baotai replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10 guichou, Wulitunasson left Chahar command and Baotai replaced him.

sentences.zh: 命伍爾伍遜為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Wuerwusun was made Kobdo assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wuerwusun became Kobdo assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以佛住為烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Fotu was made Uliasutai assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Fotu became Uliasutai assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 賑吉林打牲烏拉等處水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims at Jilin hunting stations including Daqsheng Wula were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin hunting stations including Daqsheng Wula received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 己未，睢寧決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Suining breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the Suining breach closed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賑湖南華容等縣水災。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, flood victims in Huarong and other counties in Hunan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Hunan flood victims in Huarong and other counties were relieved.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，安南國王阮光平以受封進謝恩貢物，允之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiyou: King Nguyễn Quang Bình of Annam, having received enfeoffment, presented thanks-and-grace tribute; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11 yiyou, enfeoffed Nguyễn Quang Bình's thanks tribute was accepted.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，免安徽宿州等十四州縣衛逋賦。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, arrears of land tax and grain in fourteen Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Suzhou were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, tax arrears were forgiven in fourteen Anhui districts including Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命福康安將黎維祁及其屬人送京師，隸漢軍旗籍，以黎維祁為世管佐領。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Fukang'an was ordered to escort Le Viet Ki and his dependents to the capital, enroll them in the Han Banner register, and appoint Le Viet Ki hereditary company commander.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Fukang'an brought Le Viet Ki to Beijing as a Han Banner company commander.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，四川總督李世傑病，命侍衛慶成帶醫診視，以孫士毅署之，彭元瑞署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Sichuan governor-general Li Shijie fell ill; guard Qingcheng was sent with physicians to examine him; Sun Shiyi acted in his post and Peng Yuanrui in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Li Shijie was ill; Qingcheng brought doctors while Sun Shiyi and Peng Yuanrui filled in for him.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，免盛京等五城借倉穀。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, grain borrowed from granaries by people in five Shenyang-area cities was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Shenyang-area granary loans were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，追奪故大學士馮銓等諡。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengshen: posthumous titles were stripped from the late Grand Secretary Feng Quan and others.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the twelfth month, Feng Quan and others lost their posthumous titles.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上以來年八旬萬壽，命鐫八徵耄念之寶。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, because his eightieth-birthday longevity celebration would fall next year, the Emperor ordered the seal "Ba Zheng Mao Nian Zhi Bao" engraved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Hongli ordered an eighty-year longevity seal carved ahead of next year's birthday.

sentences.zh: 五十五年春正月壬午朔，以八旬萬壽，頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: Fifty-fifth year, spring, first month, new moon on day renwu: because of the eightieth-birthday longevity celebration, an edict granted favors by degree.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifty-fifth year, on the first-month new moon, graded amnesties were proclaimed for Hongli's eightieth birthday.

sentences.zh: 普免各直省錢糧。

translations.literal: Land tax and grain dues in all provinces were broadly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All provinces received a general remission of land tax and grain.

sentences.zh: 己丑，頒恩詔於朝鮮、安南、琉球、暹羅等國。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the grace edict was promulgated to Korea, Annam, Ryukyu, Siam, and other states.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the amnesty edict went to Korea, Vietnam, Ryukyu, Siam, and others.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賞大學士和珅黃帶、四開褉袍。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Grand Secretary Heshen was awarded a yellow belt and a four-panel surcoat.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Heshen received a yellow belt and ceremonial surcoat.

sentences.zh: 賜安南國王阮光平金黃鞓帶。

translations.literal: The Annam king Nguyen Quang Binh was granted a golden yellow sash belt.
translations.idiomatic: King Nguyen Quang Binh of Vietnam received a golden yellow belt.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，朝鮮國王李算表賀萬壽，貢方物。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Korea's King Yi San memorialized congratulations on the longevity celebration and presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, King Yi San of Korea sent birthday congratulations and tribute.

sentences.zh: 己酉，琉球國王尚穆進表謝恩，貢方物。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Ryukyu's King Shang Mu submitted a memorial of thanks and presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, King Shang Mu of Ryukyu sent thanks and tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子朔，以河南考城城工錯繆，降江蘭道員，畢沅等褫職，仍留任。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day renzi: because Kaicheng city works in Henan had errors, the Jiang-Lan circuit intendant was demoted and Bi Yuan and others stripped of office but kept at their posts.
