translations.idiomatic: On the second-month new moon, Henan wall errors cost Bi Yuan and others their titles while they remained on duty.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，免直隸永清、武清五十四年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guichou, quota land tax for Yongqing and Wuqing in Zhili for the fifty-fourth year's flood was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Zhili flood taxes for the fifty-fourth year were forgiven at Yongqing and Wuqing.

sentences.zh: 己未，上詣東陵、西陵，巡幸山東，免經過直隸州縣錢糧十分之三。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor went to the Eastern and Western Tombs, toured Shandong, and remitted three-tenths of land tax and grain in Zhili districts along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Hongli toured the tombs and Shandong, cutting transit taxes in Zhili by three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor paid respects at Zhaoxi, Xiao, and Xiao East Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Emperor visited the Zhaoxi, Xiao, and Xiao East Tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上謁泰陵、泰東陵。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor paid respects at the Tai Tomb and Tai East Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Emperor visited the Tai and Tai East Tombs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，免直隸各屬節年因災緩徵錢糧。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, land tax and grain in all Zhili subordinates that had been suspended year by year because of disaster were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Zhili disaster-deferred taxes accumulated over years were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命福康安帶同阮光平入覲，郭世勛兼署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Fukang'an was ordered to bring Nguyen Quang Binh to audience; Guo Shixun served concurrently as Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Fukang'an escorted Nguyen Quang Binh to court while Guo Shixun acting headed Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，免雲南通海等五州縣五十四年分地震災田額賦，併除傍海震沒田賦。

translations.literal: On day yihai, quota land tax for earthquake disaster fields in five Yunnan subprefectures and counties including Tonghai for the fifty-fourth year was remitted, and tax on fields lost to the sea in the quake was also removed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yunnan earthquake taxes for the fifty-fourth year were forgiven, including fields swallowed by the sea.

sentences.zh: 免經過山東錢糧十分之三。

translations.literal: Three-tenths of land tax and grain in Shandong districts along the route were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Transit districts in Shandong received a three-tenths tax cut.

sentences.zh: 降直隸總督劉峨侍郎，以梁肯堂為直隸總督，調穆和藺為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhili governor-general Liu E was demoted to vice minister; Liang Kentang became Zhili governor-general and Mu Helan was transferred to Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Liu E was demoted; Liang Kentang took Zhili and Mu Helan, Henan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，免山東各屬因災緩徵銀兩。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, silver dues in all Shandong subordinates that had been suspended because of disaster were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Shandong disaster-deferred silver payments were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 以福崧為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Fu Song was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Song became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，上登岱。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiyou: the Emperor ascended Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor climbed Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上謁少昊陵。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor paid respects at Shaohao's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Emperor visited the tomb of Shaohao.

sentences.zh: 至曲阜謁先師廟。

translations.literal: He reached Qufu and paid respects at the Confucius temple.
translations.idiomatic: At Qufu he visited the temple of the Master.

sentences.zh: 乙未，釋奠。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the libation sacrifice was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, he performed the Confucian sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 賜衍聖公孔憲培及孔氏族人等章服銀幣有差。

translations.literal: The Duke Yansheng Kong Xianpei and Kong clansmen were granted regalia, silver, and coins by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Xianpei and the Kong lineage received graded robes, silver, and coins.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上謁孔林。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor paid respects at the Kong forest tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the Emperor visited the Kong cemetery.

sentences.zh: 庚子，免烏魯木齊各州縣額徵地糧十分之一。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, one-tenth of levied land grain in all Urumqi prefectures and counties was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Urumqi land grain was cut by one-tenth.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，緬甸國長孟隕遣使表賀萬壽，貢馴象，請封號。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Burma's chief Meng Yun sent envoys to congratulate on the longevity celebration, presented tame elephants, and requested enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Meng Yun of Burma sent birthday envoys with elephants and sought a title.

sentences.zh: 命封為緬甸國王。

translations.literal: He was ordered enfeoffed King of Burma.
translations.idiomatic: He was created king of Burma.

sentences.zh: 免直隸昌平等七州縣水災旗地租銀。

translations.literal: Rent silver on Banner lands in seven Zhili prefectures and counties including Changping that had suffered flood was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Flood rents on Banner land in seven Zhili districts including Changping were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 南掌國王召溫猛表賀萬壽，貢馴象。

translations.literal: The king of Nanzhang Zhaowenmeng memorialized congratulations on the longevity celebration and presented tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Nanzhang's king sent birthday elephants.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免直隸長蘆等五場上年水災灶課。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, salt-field taxes at five Zhili sites including Changlu for last year's flood were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Changlu-area salt works' flood taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，上幸天津府。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingsi: the Emperor visited Tianjin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the Emperor went to Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 諭伍拉納查浙江浮收漕糧情弊。

translations.literal: Wulana was instructed to investigate abuses in Zhejiang's excess collection of tribute grain transport levies.
translations.idiomatic: Wulana was told to probe Zhejiang canal-grain overcharges.

sentences.zh: 己未，大學士嵇璜重與恩榮宴，御制詩章賜之。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Grand Secretary Ji Huang again received the Grace and Glory Banquet and imperial poems were bestowed on him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Ji Huang was again feted at court and given imperial verse.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命吉慶會同嵩椿勘明英額邊至靉陽邊。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Ji Qing and Songchun were ordered jointly to survey and clarify the boundary from Ying'e to Aiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Ji Qing and Songchun were to fix the Ying'e–Aiyang frontier.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，免安徽宿州、靈壁等八州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yichou, quota land tax for last year's flood in eight Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Suzhou and Lingbi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, last year's flood taxes were forgiven in eight Anhui districts including Suzhou and Lingbi.

sentences.zh: 上還京師。

translations.literal: The Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Hongli prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 閔鶚元罷，調福崧為江蘇巡撫，何裕城為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Min E'yuan was dismissed; Fu Song was transferred to Jiangsu governor and He Yucheng to Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Min E'yuan was removed; Fu Song took Jiangsu and He Yucheng, Anhui.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以書麟覆奏欺飾，下部嚴議，仍留任。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, because Shu Lin's memorial reply had deceit, he was referred to the boards for stern deliberation but kept at his post.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Shu Lin faced strict review for deceitful reporting but stayed in office.

sentences.zh: 閔鶚元褫職逮問。

translations.literal: Min E'yuan was stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: Min E'yuan was deposed and jailed for trial.

sentences.zh: 壬申，免河南永城五十四年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Yongcheng's fifty-fourth-year flood quota land tax in Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Henan flood taxes for the fifty-fourth year at Yongcheng were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以孫士毅為四川總督，李世傑為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Sun Shiyi was made Sichuan governor-general and Li Shijie Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Sun Shiyi took Sichuan and Li Shijie, War.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜石韞玉等九十七人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Shi Yunyu and ninety-six others were granted metropolitan graduate degrees and origins by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, ninety-seven men including Shi Yunyu received jinshi ranks.

sentences.zh: 己卯，免山西太原、遼州等十六府州並歸化城等處額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day jimao, three-tenths of quota land tax in sixteen Shanxi prefectures including Taiyuan and Liaozhou and at Guisihua City and elsewhere was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Shanxi land tax was cut by three-tenths in sixteen districts and at Guisihua.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，上幸避暑山莊。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengyin: the Emperor went to the Mountain Estate for Escaping the Heat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Emperor went to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賞黎維祁三品職銜。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Le Viet Ki was awarded third-rank office title.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Le Viet Ki received third-rank rank.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，免西藏所屬三十九部落錢糧。

translations.literal: On day renyin, land tax and grain for Tibet's thirty-nine subject tribes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, tax was forgiven for Tibet's thirty-nine tribes.

sentences.zh: 己酉，書麟褫職逮問，福崧兼署兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Shu Lin was stripped of office and arrested for trial; Fu Song concurrently served as Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Shu Lin was deposed and arrested; Fu Song acting headed Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 韓鑅赴江南幫辦河工。

translations.literal: Han Heng went to Jiangnan to assist in river works.
translations.idiomatic: Han Heng was sent to Jiangnan for river works.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，調孫士毅為兩江總督，保寧署四川總督，永保署伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi: Sun Shiyi was transferred to Liangjiang governor-general; Baoning acted as Sichuan governor-general and Yongbao as Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the sixth month, Sun Shiyi took Liangjiang; Baoning and Yongbao acting filled Sichuan and Ili.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以陳用敷為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Chen Yongfu was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Chen Yongfu became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 閔鶚元論斬。

translations.literal: Min E'yuan was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: Min E'yuan was condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，免直隸霸州等五十四廳州縣並各屬旗地上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, last year's flood quota land tax in fifty-four Zhili circuits, prefectures, and counties including Bazhou and on subordinate Banner lands was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, last year's Zhili flood taxes in fifty-four districts and Banner lands were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊午，除湖南乾州等五廳縣苗民雜糧。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, miscellaneous grain levies on Miao people in five Hunan circuits and counties including Qianzhou were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Miao miscellaneous grain taxes in five Hunan districts including Qianzhou were ended.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，安南國王阮光平入覲。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jichou: the Annam king Nguyen Quang Binh entered audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, King Nguyen Quang Binh of Vietnam came to court.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以朱珪為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Zhu Gui was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Zhu Gui became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賑直隸朝陽、天津水災。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, flood victims in Chaoyang and Tianjin in Zhili were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Chaoyang and Tianjin received Zhili flood relief.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賑奉天錦州九關台，山東平原、禹城等縣水災。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, flood victims at Jiuguantai in Fengtian's Jinzhou and in Shandong counties including Pingyuan and Yucheng were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, flood relief was given at Jinzhou Jiuguantai and Shandong's Pingyuan and Yucheng.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，兵部尚書李世傑以失察書吏休致。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Minister of War Li Shijie retired for failure to oversee clerks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Li Shijie retired from War for lax oversight of clerks.

sentences.zh: 己亥，起劉峨為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Liu E was recalled and made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Liu E was recalled to head War.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇碭山等縣，安徽宿州，河南永城、夏邑水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims in Jiangsu counties including Dangshan, Suzhou in Anhui, and Yongcheng and Xiayi in Henan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to Dangshan and other Jiangsu counties, Suzhou, and Yongcheng and Xiayi.

sentences.zh: 江蘇碭山王平庄河決。

translations.literal: The Wangpingzhuang river in Jiangsu's Dangshan breached.
translations.idiomatic: The Wangpingzhuang breach opened in Dangshan, Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 命福崧赴宿州辦河工。

translations.literal: Fu Song was ordered to go to Suzhou to manage river works.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Song was sent to Suzhou for river works.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賑山東臨清水災。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, flood victims in Shandong's Linqing were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Linqing received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，暹羅國王鄭華表賀萬壽，貢方物。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengxu: Siam's King Zheng Hua memorialized congratulations on the longevity celebration and presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the eighth month, King Zheng Hua of Siam sent birthday tribute.

sentences.zh: 琅玕以失察漕糧自劾，罷之。

translations.literal: Langgan impeached himself for failure to oversee tribute grain and was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Langgan resigned over canal grain and was removed.

sentences.zh: 調海寧為浙江巡撫，書麟為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Haining was transferred to Zhejiang governor and Shu Lin to Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Haining took Zhejiang and Shu Lin, Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上八旬萬壽節，御太和殿，王、貝勒、貝子、公、文武大臣，蒙古汗、王、貝勒、貝子、公、額駙、台吉，回部王、公、台吉、伯克，哈薩克、安南國王、朝鮮、緬甸、南掌貢使，各省土司，台灣生番等行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, on the eightieth-birthday longevity festival, the Emperor took the throne in the Hall of Supreme Harmony; princes, beile, beizi, dukes, civil and military grandees, Mongol khans, princes, beile, beizi, dukes, imperial sons-in-law and taiji, Muslim kings, dukes, taiji and beks, Kazakh, Annam king, Korean, Burmese, and Nanzhang tribute envoys, provincial native chiefs, and Taiwan aborigines all performed congratulatory rites.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Hongli's eightieth birthday was celebrated at the Hall of Supreme Harmony with princes, ministers, Mongols, Muslims, foreign envoys, native chiefs, and Taiwan tribes paying homage.

sentences.zh: 禮成，寧壽宮、乾清宮賜宴如儀。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, banquets were given at the Palace of Tranquil Longevity and the Palace of Heavenly Purity according to ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: After the rites, ceremonial banquets were held at Ningshou and Qianqing Palaces.

sentences.zh: 己巳，刑部尚書喀寧阿卒，以明亮代之，命舒常兼署。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Minister of Punishments Kaning'a died; Mingliang succeeded him and Shuchang was ordered to serve concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Kaning'a died; Mingliang took Punishments and Shuchang acted.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，賑安徽泗州水災。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuyin: flood victims in Anhui's Sizhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Sizhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命安南國王阮光平歸黎維祁親屬及舊臣之在其國者。

translations.literal: On day guawei, the Annam king Nguyen Quang Binh was ordered to return Le Viet Ki's kin and former ministers still in his country.
translations.idiomatic: On guawei day, Nguyen Quang Binh was told to send back Le Viet Ki's family and old ministers.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor reviewed Vanguard Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Emperor reviewed Vanguard Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賑山東平原等二十七州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, flood victims in twenty-seven Shandong prefectures and counties including Pingyuan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, twenty-seven Shandong districts including Pingyuan received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 庚子，長麟以讞獄不實褫職，調惠齡為山東巡撫，以福寧為湖北巡撫，畢沅兼署之。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Chang Lin was stripped of office for an untrue case judgment; Hui Ling was transferred to Shandong governor, Fu Ning to Hubei governor, and Bi Yuan served concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Chang Lin was deposed over a false verdict; Hui Ling took Shandong, Fu Ning Hubei, and Bi Yuan acted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，賑山東平原等二十七州縣水災。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingchen: flood victims in twenty-seven Shandong prefectures and counties including Pingyuan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the tenth month, twenty-seven Shandong districts including Pingyuan were relieved again.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命保寧回伊犁將軍，以鄂輝為四川總督。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Baoning was ordered back as Ili general and E'hui made Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Baoning returned to Ili and E'hui took Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以福崧為浙江巡撫，起長麟署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Fu Song was made Zhejiang governor and Chang Lin recalled to act as Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Fu Song took Zhejiang and Chang Lin was recalled to acting Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 賑甘肅皋蘭等三縣霜災。

translations.literal: Frost victims in three Gansu counties including Gaolan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Gaolan and two other Gansu counties received frost relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑朔，以浦霖為福建巡撫，馮光熊為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day dingchou: Pu Lin was made Fujian governor and Feng Guangxiong Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh-month new moon, Pu Lin took Fujian and Feng Guangxiong Hunan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，加大學士王傑太子太保，尚書彭元瑞、董誥、胡季堂、福長安、將軍保寧太子少保。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Grand Secretary Wang Jie was promoted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent; Ministers Peng Yuanrui, Dong Gao, Hu Jitang, and Fu Chang'an and General Baoning Lesser Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Wang Jie became Grand Guardian and Peng Yuanrui, Dong Gao, Hu Jitang, Fu Chang'an, and Baoning Lesser Guardian.

sentences.zh: 乙未，釋富勒渾、雅德。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Fulehun and Yade were released.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Fulehun and Yade were freed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命慶成同尹壯圖往山西盤查倉庫。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Qingcheng and Yin Zhuangtu were ordered to go to Shanxi to inspect granaries and treasuries.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Qingcheng and Yin Zhuangtu were sent to audit Shanxi storehouses.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賑奉天錦縣等三州縣水。

translations.literal: On day renxu, flood victims in three Fengtian prefectures and counties including Jinzhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, three Fengtian districts including Jinzhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命吏部尚書彭元瑞協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Minister of Personnel Peng Yuanrui was ordered to assist the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Peng Yuanrui of Personnel was assigned to the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五十六年春正月丁丑，賑江蘇蕭縣等三縣、安徽宿州等三州縣上年水災。

translations.literal: Fifty-sixth year, spring, first month, day dingchou: last year's flood victims in three Jiangsu counties including Xiaoxian and three Anhui prefectures and counties including Suzhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifty-sixth year, flood victims in three Jiangsu and three Anhui districts received relief.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賑直隸文安等三十州縣、山東平原等二十七州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jimao, flood victims in thirty Zhili prefectures and counties including Wen'an and twenty-seven Shandong prefectures and counties including Pingyuan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, thirty Zhili districts including Wen'an and twenty-seven Shandong districts including Pingyuan received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以尹壯圖覆奏欺罔，褫職治罪。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, because Yin Zhuangtu's memorial reply had deceived, he was stripped of office and punished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Yin Zhuangtu was deposed and punished for deceitful reporting.

sentences.zh: 戊戍，袁鳳鳴處斬。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Yuan Fengming was executed by decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Yuan Fengming was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、暹羅、緬甸均遣使謝恩，貢方物。

translations.literal: Korea, Siam, and Burma all sent envoys to express thanks and presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Siam, and Burma all sent thanks and tribute.

sentences.zh: 賞賚筵宴如例。

translations.literal: Rewards and banquet gifts were bestowed according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards and banquets were given as usual.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以保寧為御前大臣。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Baoning was made palace attendant grandee before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Baoning became an imperial presence grandee.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，調劉墉為禮部尚書，紀昀為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Liu Yong was transferred to Minister of Rites and Ji Yun to Left Censor-in-chief of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Liu Yong took Rites and Ji Yun the Censorate's left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，諭：「朕孜孜求治，兢惕為懷。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiyou, an edict said: "I diligently seek good government and hold vigilance in mind.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, jiyou, the Emperor said he sought good rule with vigilance in mind.

sentences.zh: 尹壯圖逞臆妄言，亦不妨以謗為規。

translations.literal: Yin Zhuangtu's reckless presumptuous words may also be taken as admonition through criticism.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Zhuangtu's rash words might still serve as criticism turned counsel.

sentences.zh: 加恩免尹壯圖治罪，以內閣侍讀用。

translations.literal: In grace he was spared punishment and Yin Zhuangtu was used as a Grand Secretariat reader.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Zhuangtu was spared and appointed a Grand Secretariat reader.

sentences.zh: 」戊午，御試翰林詹事等官，擢阮元等二員為一等，餘升黜有差。

translations.literal: " On day wuwu, the palace examination of Hanlin academicians and related officials was held; Ruan Yuan and one other were raised to first class, the rest promoted or demoted by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the palace exam raised Ruan Yuan and one other to first class; others moved by degree.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，賑奉天錦州等處上年水災旗地人戶，並蠲租有差。

translations.literal: Third month, day yihai, banner households in Fengtian, Jinzhou, and elsewhere were given relief for last year's flood on banner lands, with rent remitted by degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, yihai, Fengtian and Jinzhou banner flood victims were relieved and rent forgiven in grades.

sentences.zh: 戍寅，上幸盤山。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor visited Panshan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor visited Panshan.

sentences.zh: 甲申，免甘肅皋蘭等三縣上年霜災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, quota tax was remitted for last year's frost damage in three Gansu counties including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, three Gansu counties including Gaolan lost last year's frost quota tax.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以永保為內大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Yongbao was made an interior minister.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Yongbao became an interior minister.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，免山東臨清等三十州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingmao: quota tax was remitted for last year's flood damage in thirty Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, dingmao, thirty Shandong districts including Linqing lost last year's flood quota tax.

sentences.zh: 辛未，彭元瑞以瞻徇降侍郎，命孫士毅為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Peng Yuanrui was demoted to vice minister for favoritism; Sun Shiyi was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Peng Yuanrui fell to vice minister for favoritism and Sun Shiyi took Personnel.

sentences.zh: 以書麟為兩江總督，長麟暫署。

translations.literal: Shu Lin was made Liangjiang governor-general and Chang Lin acted temporarily.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Lin became Liangjiang governor-general and Chang Lin acted.

sentences.zh: 調馮光熊為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Feng Guangxiong was transferred to Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guangxiong became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 以姜晟為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Jiang Sheng was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Sheng became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，以長麟為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengyin: Chang Lin was made Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, gengyin, Chang Lin became Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor went to Mulan for the autumn battue.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor went to Mulan for the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the court halted at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰朔，免直隸霸州等六十九廳州縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day jiachen: quota tax was remitted for last year's flood damage in sixty-nine Zhili departmental cities, prefectures, and counties including Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth-month new moon, jiachen, sixty-nine Zhili districts including Bazhou lost last year's flood quota tax.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，免江蘇江寧等五府州屬因災積逋半賦。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengchen: half of disaster arrears tax was remitted for five Jiangsu prefectures including Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, gengchen, half of disaster arrears was forgiven in five Jiangsu prefectures including Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以緬甸國王孟隕資送羈留內地人民，嘉賚之。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Burmese king Meng Yun was rewarded for sending back people detained in the interior.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Burma's King Meng Yun was rewarded for returning detained subjects.

sentences.zh: 己亥，蠲安徽宿州等十九州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jihai, quota tax was remitted for last year's flood in nineteen Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, nineteen Anhui districts including Suzhou lost last year's flood quota tax.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，蠲陝西朝邑等二縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, arrears tax was remitted for two Shaanxi counties including Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Chaoyi and one other Shaanxi county lost tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，命喇特納錫第為喀喇沁札薩克一等塔布囊。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingwei: Latnasidi was made Kharchin jasak first-rank tabunang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, dingwei, Latnasidi became Kharchin jasak first-rank tabunang.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor went to Mulan for the encampment hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the Emperor went to Mulan for the encampment hunt.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor conducted the hunt encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Emperor held the hunt encampment.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀以逋欠誘圍喇嘛、噶布倫，擾西藏。

translations.literal: Gurkha, citing arrears, lured and besieged lamas and gambo and disturbed Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Gurkha, claiming arrears, lured lamas and gambo and raided Tibet.

sentences.zh: 命四川總督鄂輝、將軍成德剿之。

translations.literal: Sichuan governor-general E Hui and general Cheng De were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: E Hui and Cheng De were sent from Sichuan to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 命孫士毅署四川總督。

translations.literal: Sun Shiyi was ordered to act as Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi was told to act as Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命福康安來京祝其母生辰，郭世勛署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Fukang'an was ordered to come to the capital for his mother's birthday; Guo Shixun acted as Guangdong-Guangxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Fukang'an came to Beijing for his mother's birthday and Guo Shixun acted at Liang-Guang.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀陷西藏定日各寨，據濟嚨。

translations.literal: Gurkha captured various Tibetan dzong districts at Dingri and held Gyirong.
translations.idiomatic: Gurkha took Dingri dzongs and held Gyirong.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，上回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingzi: the Emperor returned and halted at the Summer Resort.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, bingzi, the Emperor returned to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，召嵩椿回京，以琳寧為盛京將軍，調恆秀為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Songchun was recalled; Linning was made Shengjing general and Hengxiu transferred to Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Songchun was recalled; Linning took Shengjing and Hengxiu Jilin.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上回蹕。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor escorted the imperial progress back.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the court escorted the return journey.

sentences.zh: 戊子，唐古忒兵與達木蒙古兵御廓爾喀失利，唐古忒公札什納木札勒及達木協領澤巴傑等死之。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Tibetan troops and Dami Mongol troops met Gurkha in defeat; Tibetan duke Tashinamgyal and Dami assistant commandant Zepajie and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Tibetan and Dami troops were beaten; Duke Tashinamgyal and Assistant Commandant Zepajie died.

sentences.zh: 命乾清門侍衛額勒登保等赴西藏軍營。

translations.literal: Imperial Bodyguard Eledengbao and others were ordered to the Tibet army camp.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao and other imperial bodyguards were sent to the Tibet front.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以保泰懦怯褫職，命奎林赴藏辦事，賞舒濂副都統銜，協同辦理。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Baotai was dismissed for cowardice; Kuilin was sent to Tibet and Shu Lian given vice commandant insignia to assist.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Baotai was dismissed for cowardice; Kuilin went to Tibet and Shu Lian assisted as vice commandant.

sentences.zh: 以達賴喇嘛等堅守布達拉，嘉獎之。

translations.literal: The Dalai Lama and others were praised for firmly holding the Potala.
translations.idiomatic: The Dalai Lama and others were praised for holding the Potala.

sentences.zh: 命劉墉署吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Liu Yong was ordered to act as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yong was told to act as Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以廓爾喀圍紥什倫布，諭鄂輝等進剿。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, because Gurkha besieged Tashilhunpo, E Hui and others were instructed to advance and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, with Tashilhunpo besieged, E Hui and others were told to advance.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，豁奉天廣寧縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, arrears tax was remitted for Fengtian Guangning County.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Fengtian Guangning lost tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，宥閔鶚元罪。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yisi: Min Egui's crime was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, yisi, Min Egui was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丁未，廓爾喀入紥什倫布，尋遁去。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Gurkha entered Tashilhunpo and soon fled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Gurkha entered Tashilhunpo and soon withdrew.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，戶部尚書巴延三以浮估城工褫職，調福長安代之。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Minister of Revenue Bayansan was dismissed for inflated estimates on city works; Fu Chang'an replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Bayansan lost Revenue for inflated city estimates and Fu Chang'an replaced him.

sentences.zh: 以金簡、彭元瑞為滿、漢工部尚書。

translations.literal: Jin Jian and Peng Yuanrui were made Manchu and Han Ministers of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Jian and Peng Yuanrui became Manchu and Han Works ministers.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以安南開關通巿，改廣西龍州通判同知。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, because Annam opened customs for trade, the Guangxi Longzhou subprefecture judge was changed to subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, with Annam trade open, Longzhou's judge became subprefect.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，諭王大臣不必兼議政虛銜。

translations.literal: On day yichou, an edict said princes and ministers need not hold empty concurrent Council of State titles.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, princes and ministers were told not to keep empty Council titles.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，授福康安為將軍，海蘭察、奎林為參贊，征廓爾喀。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guiyou: Fukang'an was made general, Hai Lancha and Kuilin collegial pacification officers, to campaign against Gurkha.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, guiyou, Fukang'an became general and Hai Lancha and Kuilin joined the Gurkha campaign.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，鄂輝、成德褫職，以惠齡為四川總督，奎林為成都將軍，吉慶為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, E Hui and Cheng De were dismissed; Huiling became Sichuan governor-general, Kuilin Chengdu general, and Ji Qing Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, E Hui and Cheng De were dismissed; Huiling took Sichuan, Kuilin Chengdu, and Ji Qing Shandong.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以陳淮為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Chen Huai was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Chen Huai became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，命海蘭察等及索倫、達呼爾兵由西寧進藏。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai: Hai Lancha and others and Solon and Daur troops were ordered into Tibet via Xining.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, xinhai, Hai Lancha, Solon, and Daur troops were sent into Tibet via Xining.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，召都爾嘉回京。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Duerjia was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Duerjia was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以明亮為黑龍江將軍，明興為喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Mingliang was made Heilongjiang general and Mingxing Kashgar collegial pacification officer.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang became Heilongjiang general and Mingxing Kashgar collegial officer.

sentences.zh: 五十七年春正月壬申，賞七代一堂致仕上駟院卿李質穎御書扁額。

translations.literal: Fifty-seventh year, spring, first month, day renshen: retired Stable Court president Li Zhiying, seven generations alive under one roof, was awarded an imperial inscribed plaque.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 57, renshen, retired Stable Court president Li Zhiying, seven generations under one roof, received an imperial plaque.

sentences.zh: 免奉天、直隸、安徽、湖南、廣東逋賦。

translations.literal: Arrears tax was remitted in Fengtian, Zhili, Anhui, Hunan, and Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Tax arrears were forgiven in Fengtian, Zhili, Anhui, Hunan, and Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以達賴喇嘛復遣丹津班珠爾等私與廓爾喀議和，諭止之。

translations.literal: On day yihai, because the Dalai Lama again sent Danjinbanzhu'er and others to negotiate privately with Gurkha, they were instructed to stop.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Dalai Lama's private Gurkha envoys were ordered to stop.

sentences.zh: 丙子，追論巴忠與廓爾喀議和擅許歲銀罪。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Baa Zhong's crime of negotiating with Gurkha and unilaterally promising annual silver was pursued.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Baa Zhong was charged for private Gurkha talks and promised tribute silver.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以蘇凌阿為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Su Ling'a was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Su Ling'a became Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，成德奏敗賊於拍甲嶺。

translations.literal: Second month, day renyin: Cheng De reported defeating the enemy at Paijialing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, renyin, Cheng De reported victory at Paijialing.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，予大學士阿桂等、尚書福長安等、侍郎德明等、總督福康安等、巡撫長麟等敘。

translations.literal: On day guimao, rewards were granted to Grand Secretary Agui, Minister Fu Chang'an, Vice Minister De Ming, Governor-general Fukang'an, Governor Chang Lin, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Agui, Fu Chang'an, De Ming, Fukang'an, Chang Lin, and others were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 裁河東鹽政、鹽運使等官。

translations.literal: Hedong salt controller, salt transport commissioner, and other posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong salt controller and transport posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 移山西河東道駐運城。

translations.literal: Shanxi Hedong Circuit was moved to garrison at Yuncheng.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi Hedong Circuit was stationed at Yuncheng.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命皇十五子嘉親王祭先師孔子。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the fifteenth imperial son, Prince Jia, was ordered to sacrifice to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the fifteenth son, Prince Jia, sacrificed to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 免奉天錦州府屬上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota tax was remitted for last year's drought in Fengtian Jinzhou prefecture dependencies.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's drought quota tax was forgiven in Fengtian Jinzhou dependencies.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命侍郎和琳管理藏務。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Vice Minister Helin was ordered to manage Tibet affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Helin was told to manage Tibet affairs.

sentences.zh: 鄂輝等奏收復聶拉木，諭以遲延斥之。

translations.literal: E Hui and others reported recovering Nyalam; they were rebuked for delay.
translations.idiomatic: E Hui reported Nyalam recovered and was rebuked for delay.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，上詣西陵，巡幸五台山，免經過地方本年錢糧十分之三。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: the Emperor went to the Western Tombs and toured Wutai Mountain, remitting three-tenths of this year's land tax in passed areas.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, dingchou, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and Wutai Mountain and cut three-tenths of land tax along the route.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，允濟嚨呼圖克圖「慧通禪師」法號。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Gyirong khutukhtu was granted the dharma title "Chan Master Huitong."
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Gyirong khutukhtu received the title Chan Master Huitong.

sentences.zh: 以帕克哩營官番眾收復哲孟雄、宗木，賚之。

translations.literal: Pakli camp Tibetan officials who recovered Doklam and Drongme were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Pakli officials who recovered Doklam and Drongme were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上謁泰陵、泰東陵。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor visited the Tailing and East Tailing tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Emperor visited the Tailing and East Tailing.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免直隸大興等八州縣積欠米穀。

translations.literal: On day renwu, accumulated grain arrears were remitted in eight Zhili prefectures and counties including Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, eight Zhili districts including Daxing lost grain arrears.

sentences.zh: 甲申，加福康安大將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Fukang'an was advanced to grand general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Fukang'an became grand general.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，免五台本年錢糧十分之五，大同、朔平二府屬未完逋賦。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, half of Wutai's land tax was remitted and unpaid arrears in Datong and Shuoping dependencies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Wutai lost half its land tax and Datong and Shuoping lost arrears.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上駐蹕五台山。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor halted at Wutai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the court halted at Wutai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥朔，以和闐辦事大臣李侍政失察邁瑪特尼雜爾，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on day jihai: Khotan Affairs minister Li Shizheng was referred for strict discipline for failure to detect Maimaitiniyazi'er.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth-month new moon, jihai, Li Shizheng was disciplined for missing Maimaitiniyazi'er.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上閱滹沱河。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Emperor inspected the Hutuo River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Emperor inspected the Hutuo River.

sentences.zh: 以貢楚克紥布為烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Gunchukezhabu was made Uliastai collegial pacification officer.
translations.idiomatic: Gunchukezhabu became Uliastai collegial officer.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上祭帝堯廟。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor sacrificed at the Emperor Yao temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor sacrificed at the Emperor Yao temple.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 命刑部清理庶獄，減徒以下罪。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Punishments was ordered to review ordinary prisons and reduce punishments below exile.
translations.idiomatic: Punishments ordered a prison review and reductions below exile.

sentences.zh: 閏四月甲申，以久旱，諭台灣及沿海各省詳鞫命盜各案，毋有意從嚴。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day jiashen: because of prolonged drought, Taiwan and coastal provinces were instructed to try capital and robbery cases carefully and not deliberately apply harsh penalties.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, jiashen, drought led Taiwan and coastal provinces to try capital and robbery cases without deliberate harshness.

sentences.zh: 蠲河南湯陰等五縣上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota tax was remitted for last year's drought in five Henan counties including Tangyin.
translations.idiomatic: Five Henan counties including Tangyin lost last year's drought quota tax.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以久旱，下詔求言。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, because of prolonged drought an edict sought memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, prolonged drought brought an edict seeking advice.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，雨。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 以失陷札什倫布，治仲巴呼圖克圖及孜仲喇嘛等罪。

translations.literal: For the fall of Tashilhunpo, the Shigatse khutukhtu and dzasak lamas and others were punished.
translations.idiomatic: After Tashilhunpo fell, the Shigatse khutukhtu and dzasak lamas were punished.

sentences.zh: 命和琳、鄂輝宣諭達賴喇嘛等。

translations.literal: Helin and E Hui were ordered to proclaim instructions to the Dalai Lama and others.
translations.idiomatic: Helin and E Hui were told to instruct the Dalai Lama and others.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，定安南國兩年一貢，六年遣使一朝。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinchou: Annam was fixed at tribute every two years and an embassy every six years.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, xinchou, Annam was set to tribute every two years and an embassy every six.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上幸避暑山莊，免經過地方錢糧十分之五。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor went to the Summer Resort, remitting five-tenths of land tax in passed areas.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor went to the Summer Resort and cut five-tenths of land tax along the route.

sentences.zh: 戊申，調長麟為山西巡撫，以奇豐額為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Chang Lin was transferred to Shanxi governor and Qifeng'e made Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Chang Lin took Shanxi and Qifeng'e Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，允霍罕額爾德尼伯克那爾巴圖遣使入貢。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Kokand khan Narbatu's tribute embassy was accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Kokand's Narbatu sent tribute and it was accepted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor halted at the Summer Resort.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the court halted at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，福康安奏克廓爾喀所踞擦木耍隘。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiaxu: Fukang'an reported capturing the Gurkha-held Tsam-srong pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, jiaxu, Fukang'an reported taking the Gurkha-held Tsam-srong pass.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賑江西南豐、廣昌水災。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Nanfeng and Guangchang in Jiangxi were given flood relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Jiangxi's Nanfeng and Guangchang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 福康安奏殄瑪噶爾轄爾甲山樑之賊。

translations.literal: Fukang'an reported annihilating the enemy at Magarkhal ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an reported wiping out the enemy at Magarkhal ridge.

sentences.zh: 己卯，福康安等奏克濟嚨。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Fukang'an and others reported capturing Gyirong.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Fukang'an and others reported taking Gyirong.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，調陳淮為江西巡撫，馮光熊為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Chen Huai was transferred to Jiangxi governor and Feng Guangxiong to Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Chen Huai took Jiangxi and Feng Guangxiong Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，福康安等奏攻克熱索橋。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Fukang'an and others reported capturing the Resuo Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Fukang'an and others reported taking the Resuo Bridge.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，福康安等奏攻克協布魯寨。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Fukang'an and others reported capturing the Syabru stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Fukang'an and others reported taking the Syabru stockade.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，賑直隸河間等處旱災，順直宛平、玉田等州縣蝗。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiachen: drought relief was given in Hejian and elsewhere in Zhili, and locusts in Wanping, Yutian, and other districts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, jiachen, Zhili drought districts including Hejian were relieved and locusts hit Wanping and Yutian.

sentences.zh: 己酉，福康安等克廓爾喀東覺山樑，並雅爾賽拉等處營卡，成德等克紥木、鐵索橋等處。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Fukang'an and others captured Gurkha positions at Dongjue ridge and Yarsala camp stations; Cheng De and others captured Dram and the iron-chain bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Fukang'an took Dongjue ridge and Yarsala camps and Cheng De took Dram and the iron-chain bridge.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，成德克多洛卡、隴岡等處。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinwei: Cheng De captured Duoluoka, Longgang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinwei day, Cheng De took Duoluoka, Longgang, and other posts.

sentences.zh: 命孫士毅駐前藏督糧運。

translations.literal: Sun Shiyi was ordered to remain in front Tibet to supervise grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi was posted to front Tibet to oversee grain supply.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命福康安為武英殿大學士，孫士毅為文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Fukang'an was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Martial Glory; Sun Shiyi, Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depth.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Fukang'an joined the Martial Glory grand secretariat and Sun Shiyi the Literary Depth.

sentences.zh: 調金簡、劉墉為吏部尚書，和琳為工部尚書，紀昀為禮部尚書，竇光鼐為左都御史。

translations.literal: Jin Jian and Liu Yong were transferred to be Ministers of Personnel; Helin to Works; Ji Yun to Rites; Dou Guangnai to Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Jian and Liu Yong took personnel; Helin works; Ji Yun rites; Dou Guangnai the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以博興為庫倫辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Boxing was made commissioner at Urga.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Boxing became Urga commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，福康安等奏克噶勒拉、堆補木城卡，阿滿泰、墨爾根保陣亡。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Fukang'an memorialized the capture of Gelela and Duibumu forts; A Mantai and Mo'ergenbao died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Fukang'an reported Gelela and Duibumu forts taken; A Mantai and Mo'ergenbao fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 成德等克利底、大山賊卡。

translations.literal: Cheng De and others captured the Lidi and Dashan rebel forts.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng De and others took the Lidi and Dashan rebel forts.

sentences.zh: 戊子，福康安奏廓爾喀酋拉特納巴都爾等乞降。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Fukang'an reported that Gurkha chief Ratnabhadra and others begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Fukang'an reported Gurkha chief Ratnabhadra and others seeking surrender.

sentences.zh: 上以其悔罪乞降，許之，命班師。

translations.literal: The Emperor, seeing their repentance and plea to surrender, permitted it and ordered withdrawal of the army.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor accepted their repentance and ordered the troops withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賑陝西咸寧等六州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, drought relief was given for six Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Xianning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, drought relief reached six Shaanxi districts including Xianning.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，上還京師。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingyou: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己亥，論征廓爾喀功，賞福康安一等輕車都尉，晉海蘭察二等公為一等，議敘孫士毅等各有差。

translations.literal: On day jihai, merits in the Gurkha campaign were assessed; Fukang'an was granted First-class Chariot Commandant; Hai Lancha was advanced from second- to first-rank duke; Sun Shiyi and others received differentiated rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Gurkha merits were rewarded: Fukang'an received First-class Chariot Commandant; Hai Lancha rose to first-rank duke; Sun Shiyi and others were promoted by degree.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上命福康安、孫士毅等會商西藏善後事宜。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor ordered Fukang'an, Sun Shiyi, and others to consult on postwar arrangements for Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Fukang'an, Sun Shiyi, and others were told to settle Tibet's aftermath.

sentences.zh: 命御前侍衛惠倫等齎金奔巴瓶往藏，貯呼畢勒罕名姓，由達賴喇嘛等對眾拈定。

translations.literal: Imperial bodyguards including Huilun were ordered to carry the golden urn to Tibet, store reincarnation names, and have the Dalai Lama and others draw lots before the assembly.
translations.idiomatic: Huilun and other guards took the golden urn to Tibet so the Dalai Lama and others could draw the reincarnation name in public.

sentences.zh: 壬子，復廓爾喀王公封爵，定五年一貢。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Gurkha princes' titles were restored and tribute fixed at once every five years.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Gurkha titles were restored and tribute set for every five years.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，廓爾喀貢使入覲。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuchen: Gurkha tribute envoys had audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on wuchen day, Gurkha tribute envoys were received.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賑河南安陽等十六縣災民，蠲緩新舊額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day jisi, disaster victims were relieved in sixteen Henan counties including Anyang; old and new quota taxes were remitted or deferred by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, sixteen Henan counties including Anyang were relieved and taxes remitted or deferred by degree.

sentences.zh: 己卯，免嵇璜、阿桂翰林院掌院學士，以和珅、彭元瑞代之。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Ji Huang and Agui were removed as Hanlin Academy chancellors; Heshen and Peng Yuanrui replaced them.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Ji Huang and Agui left the Hanlin chancellorship; Heshen and Peng Yuanrui succeeded them.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賑直隸河間、任丘五州縣旱災，並免順天等十三府州屬被災旗民額賦。

translations.literal: On day renwu, drought relief was given for five Zhili prefectures and counties including Hejian and Renqiu; quota taxes were also remitted for stricken banner people in thirteen Shuntian-area units.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, five Zhili districts including Hejian and Renqiu were drought-relieved and banner taxes remitted in thirteen Shuntian-area units.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，郭世燾奏英吉利遣使，請由天津進貢，允之。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Guo Shihui reported that Britain was sending envoys asking to enter tribute via Tianjin; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Guo Shihui reported a British mission via Tianjin and permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以鄂輝隱匿廓爾喀謝恩表貢褫職，交福康安等嚴鞫之。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, E Hui was stripped of office for concealing Gurkha thanks and tribute memorials and was handed to Fukang'an and others for strict interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, E Hui lost office for hiding Gurkha tribute papers and was sent to Fukang'an for interrogation.

sentences.zh: 賑陝西咸陽等十四州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Drought relief was given for fourteen Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Shaanxi districts including Xianyang received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，調圖桑阿為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Tusang'a was transferred to be Suiyuan city general.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Tusang'a became Suiyuan city general.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，賑山東德州等二十州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingwu: drought relief was given for twenty Shandong prefectures and counties including Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingwu day, twenty Shandong districts including Dezhou were drought-relieved.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，定唐古忒番兵訓練事宜。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengwu: regulations were fixed for training Tangut banner troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengwu day, Tangut banner training rules were set.

sentences.zh: 鑄銀為錢，文曰「乾隆寶藏」。

translations.literal: Silver was cast into coin inscribed "Qianlong Treasure."
translations.idiomatic: Silver was cast into coins reading "Qianlong Treasure."

sentences.zh: 甲戌，免長蘆興國等五場並滄州等七州縣被災灶地額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, quota salt-field taxes were remitted for five Changlu yards including Xingguo and seven counties including Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, salt-field taxes were remitted at five Changlu yards including Xingguo and seven counties including Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以長麟為浙江巡撫，蔣兆奎為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Chang Lin was made Zhejiang governor; Jiang Zhaokui, Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Chang Lin took Zhejiang and Jiang Zhaokui Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 以伊犁回民地畝雪災，免本年額穀。

translations.literal: Because Ili Muslim farmland suffered snow disaster, quota grain was remitted for the year.
translations.idiomatic: Ili Muslim fields hit by snow were forgiven the year's quota grain.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賑河南安陽等二十五縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, drought relief was given for twenty-five Henan counties including Anyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, twenty-five Henan counties including Anyang were drought-relieved.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命永遠枷號鄂輝等於西藏。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, E Hui and others were ordered permanently cangued in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, E Hui and others were ordered cangued forever in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 五十八年春正月丙申，賑河南林縣等五縣、陝西咸寧等三州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Fifty-eighth year, spring, first month, day bingshen: drought relief was given for five Henan counties including Lin and three Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Xianning.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifty-eighth year, on bingshen day, drought relief reached five Henan counties including Lin and three Shaanxi units including Xianning.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賑直隸保定等二十一州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day jihai, drought relief was given for twenty-one Zhili prefectures and counties including Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, twenty-one Zhili districts including Baoding were drought-relieved.

sentences.zh: 庚子，改杭州織造為鹽政兼管織造事，改鹽道為運司，南北兩關稅務歸巡撫管理。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Hangzhou weaving office was placed under the salt administration to oversee weaving concurrently; the salt intendant became transport commissioner; north and south customs were placed under the governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Hangzhou weaving was merged into salt control, the salt intendant became transport commissioner, and both customs went to the governor.

sentences.zh: 以全德為兩浙鹽政。

translations.literal: Quande was made salt commissioner of the Two Zhes.
translations.idiomatic: Quande became Two-Zhe salt commissioner.

sentences.zh: 恆秀回吉林將軍。

translations.literal: Hengxiu returned as Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: Hengxiu resumed as Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，敕諭安南國王阮光平睦鄰修好，慎守封疆，賜以糹采幣。

translations.literal: On day yisi, an edict instructed Annam's King Nguyen Quang Binh to befriend neighbors, guard borders carefully, and silks were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Nguyen Quang Binh of Annam was told to keep peace on the borders and received silks.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，安南國王阮光平卒，以世子阮光纘嗣。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, King Nguyen Quang Binh of Annam died; heir Nguyen Quang Toan succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Nguyen Quang Binh died and heir Nguyen Quang Toan succeeded in Annam.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，免河南安陽等二十五縣上年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yihai, last year's drought quota taxes were remitted for twenty-five Henan counties including Anyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, last year's drought taxes were remitted in twenty-five Henan counties including Anyang.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命喀什噶爾阿奇木伯克作為喀什噶爾協辦大臣。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Kashgar aqim beg was made Kashgar assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Kashgar aqim beg became Kashgar assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，上幸盤山。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingyou: the Emperor visited Mount Pan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingyou day, the Emperor went to Mount Pan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上駐蹕盤山。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor halted at Mount Pan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor stayed at Mount Pan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，禮部尚書常青卒，以德明代之。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Minister of Rites Chang Qing died; Deming replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Rites Minister Chang Qing died and Deming succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 戊申，諭於雍和宮設金奔巴瓶，飭理藩院堂官、掌印札薩克喇嘛等，公同掣蒙古所出之呼畢勒罕。

translations.literal: On day wushen, an edict ordered a golden urn installed at Yonghe Temple; Lifanyuan chiefs and seal-holding jasak lamas were instructed jointly to draw the Mongol-born reincarnation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, a golden urn was ordered at Yonghe Temple and Lifanyuan and jasak lamas were told to draw the Mongol reincarnation together.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上回蹕。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor returned from the tour.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor returned from the tour.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，調馮光熊為雲南巡撫，以英善為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Feng Guangxiong was transferred to be Yunnan governor; Yingshan was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Feng Guangxiong took Yunnan and Yingshan Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，領侍衛內大臣海蘭察卒。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard Hai Lancha died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Grand Minister Hai Lancha died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，命松筠為內務府總管大臣，在御前侍衛上行走。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renshen: Songyun was made chief steward of the Imperial Household and served above the imperial bodyguards.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on renshen day, Songyun became Imperial Household chief steward with rank above the guards.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，通諭設金奔巴瓶於前藏大昭及雍和宮，公同掣報出呼畢勒罕，以除王公子弟私作呼畢勒罕陋習。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, a general order directed that golden urns be installed at the Jokhang in front Tibet and at Yonghe Temple; joint drawing was to report the reincarnation and end the custom of princely sons privately claiming reincarnation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, golden urns were ordered at Lhasa's Jokhang and Yonghe Temple to end princes' private reincarnation claims.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，刪除大學士兼尚書銜、翰林院掌院學士兼禮部侍郎銜、順天府府丞兼提督學政銜。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, concurrent titles were deleted for grand secretaries with ministry rank, Hanlin chancellors with vice rites rank, and Shuntian vice magistrates with education intendant rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, several concurrent ministerial and educational titles were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賜潘世恩等八十一人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Pan Shi'en and eighty-one others received jinshi degrees by varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Pan Shi'en and eighty-one others received jinshi ranks by degree.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命於乾隆五十九年秋特開鄉試恩科，六十年春為會試恩科。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, special provincial examinations were ordered for autumn of the fifty-ninth year and metropolitan examinations for spring of the sixtieth year.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, special provincial and metropolitan exam schedules were set for years fifty-nine and sixty.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，廓爾喀歸西藏底瑪爾宗地方。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Gurkha returned Tibet's Demarjong territory.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Gurkha returned Demarjong in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 以西藏卡外之拉結、撒黨兩處歸廓爾喀。

translations.literal: Lajie and Sadang outside Tibet's passes were given to Gurkha.
translations.idiomatic: Lajie and Sadang beyond Tibet's passes went to Gurkha.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，命廣西按察使成林赴安南升隆城，賜奠冊封。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiwei: Guangxi surveillance commissioner Cheng Lin was sent to Annam's Thang Long for mourning and investiture rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yiwei day, Cheng Lin went to Thang Long for Annamese mourning and investiture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上幸避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor went to the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor went to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以明興未奏遣回人赴霍罕等處辦理外藩事件，罷喀什噶爾參贊大臣，調永保代之。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, because Mingxing had not memorialized dispatching Muslims to Khokand and elsewhere to handle foreign affairs, the Kashgar commissioner was dismissed and Yongbao was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Mingxing was punished for failing to report Muslim missions to Khokand and Yongbao replaced him at Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 以伍彌伍遜為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣，貢楚克札布為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Wu Mi'uwusun was made Tarbagatai commissioner; Gunchukejab, Kobdo commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi'uwusun took Tarbagatai and Gunchukejab Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 以特成額為烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Techeng'e was made Uliastai commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Techeng'e became Uliastai commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，加封福康安為一等忠銳嘉勇公。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Fukang'an was advanced to a first-class Duke of Loyal Valor and Courageous Merit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Fukang'an was made a first-class Duke of Loyal Valor and Courageous Merit.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor halted at the Summer Resort.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor stayed at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，賑四川泰寧地震災。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jimao: earthquake relief was given for Taining in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao day, Taining in Sichuan was earthquake-relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，英吉利貢船至天津。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Britain's tribute ship reached Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the British tribute ship reached Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 戊子，於通州起陸。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, they went ashore at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the mission landed at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 命在天津筵宴之。

translations.literal: A banquet was ordered at Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: A banquet was ordered in Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，命和琳稽覈藏商出入。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guisi: Helin was ordered to audit Tibetan merchants' comings and goings.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guisi day, Helin was told to audit Tibetan trade traffic.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命英吉利貢使等住宏雅園，金簡、伊齡阿於圓明園分別安設貢件。

translations.literal: On day renyin, British envoys were lodged at Hongya Garden; Jin Jian and Yiling'a arranged tribute items separately at Yuanmingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the British envoys stayed at Hongya Garden while Jin Jian and Yiling'a set out tribute at Yuanmingyuan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以旱命刑部清理庶獄，減徒以下罪。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, because of drought the Ministry of Punishments was ordered to clear common prisons and reduce crimes below exile.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, drought led the punishments ministry to clear common jails and reduce lesser sentences.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上御萬樹園大幄，英吉利國正使馬戛爾尼、副使斯當東等入覲。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor held court in the great tent of the Garden of Ten Thousand Trees; Britain's chief envoy Macartney, deputy envoy Staunton, and others had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Macartney, Staunton, and other British envoys were received in the Ten Thousand Trees Garden tent.

sentences.zh: 辛未，調福康安為四川總督，以惠齡暫代，長麟為兩廣總督，調吉慶為浙江巡撫，惠齡為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Fukang'an was transferred to Sichuan governor-general; Huiling acted temporarily; Chang Lin to Two Guangs governor-general; Ji Qing to Zhejiang governor; Huiling to Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Fukang'an took Sichuan, Huiling acted, Chang Lin took the Two Guangs, Ji Qing Zhejiang, and Huiling Shandong.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免長蘆官台等二場潮災灶地額賦。

translations.literal: On day renwu, tide-disaster quota salt-field taxes were remitted at two Changlu yards including Guantai.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, tide-hit salt taxes were remitted at two Changlu yards including Guantai.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以慶桂為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Qing Gui was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Qing Gui became war minister.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，諭英吉利貢使由內河水路赴廣東澳門附船回國。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, British envoys were instructed to proceed by inland waterways to Macao in Guangdong and take ship home.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the British envoys were sent by inland water to Macao to sail home.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，加長麟太子少保。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingyou: Chang Lin was made Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou day, Chang Lin became Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 命松筠護送英吉利使臣等至浙江定海。

translations.literal: Songyun was ordered to escort the British envoys to Dinghai in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun was told to escort the British envoys to Dinghai, Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，調福寧為山東巡撫，惠齡為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Funing was transferred to Shandong governor; Huiling to Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Funing took Shandong and Huiling Hubei.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以安徽無為等三州縣水災，賞口糧有差。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, because of flood in three Anhui prefectures and counties including Wuwei, grain rations were bestowed by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, flood-hit Anhui districts including Wuwei received graded grain rations.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，安南國王阮光纘表進謝恩，貢物二分，納其一。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guihai: King Nguyen Quang Toan of Annam memorialized thanks; of two shares of tribute one was accepted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on guihai day, Nguyen Quang Toan sent thanks and one of two tribute shares was accepted.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以長麟奏英吉利使稱再進表章貢物，呈總督轉奏，諭：「系援例而行，並無他意，國王可安心，再來表貢，亦不拘定年限。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, because Chang Lin reported that the British envoys said they would again submit memorials and tribute forwarded through the governor-general, an edict stated: "This follows precedent and has no other intent; the king may rest easy—future memorial tribute is not bound to fixed intervals.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, after Chang Lin relayed Britain's offer of further tribute, the throne said it followed precedent and future visits were not on a fixed schedule.
Future tribute need not follow fixed intervals.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，命和寧赴藏幫同和琳辦事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu: Hob'ning was ordered to Tibet to assist Helin in affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiawu day, Hob'ning was sent to Tibet to help Helin.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以上年各省奏報民數三萬七百四十六萬有奇，較康熙四十九年增十五倍，諭：「生之者寡，食之者眾，勢必益形拮据。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, because the previous year's provincial reports showed a population of somewhat more than 307,460,000—fifteen times that of the forty-ninth year of Kangxi—an edict stated: "Those who produce are few and those who consume are many; want will surely grow more pressing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, with reported population over 307 million, fifteen times Kangxi 49, the throne warned that producers were few and consumers many.

sentences.zh: 各省督撫及有牧民之責者，務當勸諭化導，俾皆儉樸成風，服勤稼穡，惜物力而盡地利，共享昇平之福。

translations.literal: Governors-general, governors, and all charged with nurturing the people must exhort and guide so that all form a habit of frugality, labor diligently at farming, cherish material goods and fully use the land's bounty, and together share the blessings of peace.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were told to promote thrift, farming, and careful use of resources so all might share peace.

sentences.zh: 」己未，以安南等國進象已多，諭雲貴、兩廣督撫檄卻象貢。

translations.literal: " On day jiwei, because elephants presented by Annam and other states had become too numerous, governors-general of Yunnan-Guizhou and the Two Guangs were ordered by edict to refuse elephant tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Yunnan-Guizhou and Liangguang were told to refuse further elephant tribute from Annam and others.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，伍拉納陛見，命吉慶署閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiwei: Wulana had audience; Ji Qing was ordered to act as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiwei day, Wulana was received and Ji Qing acted as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 五十九年春正月庚寅，免直隸、山東、河南逋賦十分之三。

translations.literal: Fifty-ninth year, spring, first month, day gengyin: three-tenths of tax arrears were remitted in Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifty-ninth year, on gengyin day, three-tenths of arrears were remitted in Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，管幹貞病免，命書麟兼署漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Guan Qianzhen was dismissed because of illness; Shu Lin was ordered to act as Grand Canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, ill Guan Qianzhen was dismissed and Shu Lin acted as canal transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，恆秀以侵帑褫職，調寶琳為吉林將軍，松筠署之。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Hengxiu was stripped of office for embezzlement; Baolin was transferred to Jilin general; Songyun acted in the post.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Hengxiu lost office for embezzlement, Baolin took Jilin, and Songyun acted.

sentences.zh: 戊午，安置安南內附人黎維治於江南。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Annamese adherent Le Duy Chi was settled in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Le Duy Chi of Annam was resettled in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，以明年元旦上元值日月食，諭修省，毋舉行慶典。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengshen: because New Year's Day and the Lantern Festival next year would coincide with solar and lunar eclipses, an edict called for self-examination and no celebratory observances.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen day, eclipses on New Year and Lantern Festival led the court to forgo celebrations and urge self-examination.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，廓爾喀遣使進表貢。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Gurkha sent envoys with memorial and tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Gurkha sent memorial and tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，增造廣東水師戰船。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Guangdong naval war junks were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, more Guangdong naval war junks were built.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，恆秀論絞。

translations.literal: Third month, day jichou: Hengxiu was sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jichou day, Hengxiu was sentenced to strangulation.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上巡幸天津，免經過地方及天津府屬額賦十分之三，免天津府屬逋賦，免大興等十三州縣逋賦十分之四。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor toured Tianjin; three-tenths of quota taxes were remitted on the route and in Tianjin districts; Tianjin arrears were remitted; four-tenths of arrears were remitted in thirteen districts including Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Tianjin tour brought three-tenths tax cuts on the route, Tianjin arrears forgiven, and four-tenths remitted in thirteen districts including Daxing.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上駐蹕天津府。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor halted at Tianjin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the Emperor stayed at Tianjin prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬戌，常雩，命皇八子儀郡王永璇代行禮。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renxu: regular drought prayer; the Eighth Prince, Prince Yi of the Commandery Yongxuan, was ordered to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on renxu day, Prince Yi Yongxuan performed the regular drought rites.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，京師雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingshen: rain fell in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingshen day, rain fell in the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，郭世勛病免，調朱珪為廣東巡撫，陳用敷為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Guo Shixun was dismissed owing to illness; Zhu Gui was transferred to be Guangdong governor and Chen Yongfu Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Guo Shixun left office for illness; Zhu Gui took Guangdong and Chen Yongfu, Anhui.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以直隸保定等八十三州縣旱，命賞給一月口糧。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, because eighty-three prefectures and counties including Baoding in Zhili suffered drought, one month's grain ration was ordered given as bounty.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, drought in eighty-three Zhili districts including Baoding brought a one-month grain bounty.

sentences.zh: 減奉天商販豆麥等項經過直隸、山東關津稅。

translations.literal: Transit taxes on beans, wheat, and similar goods carried by Fengtian merchants through Zhili and Shandong passes were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Bean and wheat tolls for Fengtian merchants through Zhili and Shandong were cut.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上幸避暑山莊，免經過地方錢糧有差。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, the Emperor went to the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat; land tax and grain levies on the route were remitted by varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Emperor visited the Summer Resort with graduated tax relief on the route.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰朔，以山東歷城山莊等五十一州縣旱，給貧民一月口糧，除山東臨清州水沖地畝田賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day bingchen: because fifty-one prefectures and counties including Licheng and Shanzhuang in Shandong suffered drought, poor people were given one month's grain ration, and land tax on flood-scoured fields in Linqing prefecture, Shandong, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on the new moon, fifty-one drought-struck Shandong districts got a month's grain; Linqing flood fields were tax-exempt.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Emperor stayed at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 庚午，設唐古忒西南外番布魯克巴、哲孟雄、作木朗、洛敏湯、廓爾喀各交界鄂博。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, boundary obos were established on the borders with Badakhshan, Bhutan, Zomithang, Luomintang, and Nepal on the southwest outer frontiers of Tangut.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, border obos were set with Badakhshan, Bhutan, Zomithang, Luomintang, and Nepal southwest of Tangut.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，永定河決。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuzi: the Yongding River breached.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, the Yongding River broke.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，河南丹、沁二河決。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the Dan and Qin rivers in Henan breached.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Dan and Qin rivers broke in Henan.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賑山西平定等處水災。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, flood disaster in places including Pingding in Shanxi was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, flood relief reached Pingding and other Shanxi districts.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賑山東臨清等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On jihai day, flood disaster in prefectures and counties including Linqing in Shandong was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Shandong flood relief reached Linqing and nearby districts.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賑直隸天津等處水災。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, flood disaster in places including Tianjin in Zhili was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, flood relief reached Tianjin and other Zhili districts.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，河南豐北廳曲家莊河決。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the river breached at Qujiazhuang in Fengbei subprefecture, Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the river broke at Qujiazhuang in Henan's Fengbei office.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，書麟以徇隱鹽政巴寧阿交結商人褫職，調富綱為兩江總督，命蘇凌阿署之。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Shulin was stripped of office for shielding Salt Controller Baning'a's collusion with merchants; Fugang was transferred to be governor-general of the Two Jiangs, with Suling'a ordered to act.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Shulin fell for shielding Baning'a's merchant ties; Fugang became Two Jiangs governor-general under Suling'a.

sentences.zh: 調福康安為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Fukang'an was transferred to be Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以和琳為四川總督，孫士毅署之。

translations.literal: Helin was made Sichuan governor-general, with Sun Shiyi to act.
translations.idiomatic: Helin took Sichuan; Sun Shiyi acted for him.

sentences.zh: 以駐藏辦事松筠為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Songyun, commissioner in Tibet, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet commissioner Songyun became works minister.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命馮光熊署雲貴總督。
