translations.literal: On yisi day, Feng Guangxiong was ordered to act as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Feng Guangxiong acted as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 大學士嵇璜卒，召孫士毅入閣辦事。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Ji Huang died; Sun Shiyi was summoned to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Huang died; Sun Shiyi entered the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，停本年及明年木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the Mulan enclosure hunt for this year and next was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Mulan hunts this year and next were called off.

sentences.zh: 免直隸保定等府屬、河南衛輝等府屬、山東臨清等五州縣、山西代州等三州縣被水額賦。

translations.literal: Quota tax on flood-stricken fields was remitted for Zhili prefectures and subordinates including Baoding, Henan prefectures and subordinates including Weihui, five prefectures and counties in Shandong including Linqing, and three prefectures and counties in Shanxi including Daizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Flood land tax was forgiven in Baoding-area Zhili, Weihui-area Henan, five Shandong districts including Linqing, and three Shanxi districts including Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，以直隸天津、河間二府水災重，免因災緩徵額賦。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingsi: because flood disaster in Tianjin and Hejian prefectures in Zhili was severe, deferred quota tax from the disaster was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingsi day, severe Zhili floods at Tianjin and Hejian brought remission of deferred disaster tax.

sentences.zh: 戊午，永定河南工決口合龍。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the southern-work breach on the Yongding River was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the Yongding River's southern breach closed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以明歲御宇屆六十年，普免各省漕糧一次。

translations.literal: On jisi day, because the sixtieth year of the Emperor's reign would arrive next year, grain tribute transport throughout the provinces was once universally remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, with the sixtieth regnal year approaching, all provinces' grain tribute was forgiven once.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上回蹕。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the Emperor returned from the halt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Emperor returned.

sentences.zh: 調福寧為河南巡撫，穆和藺為山東巡撫，江蘭護之。

translations.literal: Funing was transferred to be Henan governor; Mu Helian was made Shandong governor, with Jiang Lan to act.
translations.idiomatic: Funing took Henan; Mu Helian took Shandong under Jiang Lan.

sentences.zh: 福康安奏四川大寧教匪謝添秀等傳習邪教，蔓延陝西、湖北、河南，諭嚴為捕治。

translations.literal: Fukang'an memorialized that in Daning, Sichuan, sect rebel Xie Tianxiu and others propagated heterodox teachings, spreading into Shaanxi, Hubei, and Henan; strict capture and punishment were ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an reported Daning sect teachers spreading into Shaanxi, Hubei, and Henan; capture was ordered.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，免直隸通州等二十三州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, accumulated tax arrears were remitted for twenty-three prefectures and counties in Zhili including Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, back taxes were forgiven in twenty-three Zhili districts including Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，畢沅降山東巡撫，罰繳湖廣總督養廉五年。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Bi Yuan was demoted to Shandong governor and fined five years' salary supplement as former Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Bi Yuan was demoted to Shandong and fined five years of Huguang salary supplement.

sentences.zh: 以福寧為湖廣總督，穆和藺留為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Funing was made Huguang governor-general; Mu Helian remained Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Funing became Huguang governor-general; Mu Helian stayed in Henan.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，賑湖北沔陽等州縣水災。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jichou: flood disaster in prefectures and counties including Mianyang in Hubei was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jichou day, flood relief reached Mianyang and other Hubei districts.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以秀林為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Xiulin was made Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Xiulin became Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賑福建漳、泉二府水災。

translations.literal: On jihai day, flood disaster in Zhangzhou and Quanzhou prefectures in Fujian was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, flood relief reached Fujian's Zhang and Quan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 減直隸遵化內務府官地租。

translations.literal: Rent on banner lands of the Imperial Household Department in Zunhua, Zhili, was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Zunhua Imperial Household banner land rent was cut.

sentences.zh: 命福寧駐襄陽，督緝邪教案犯。

translations.literal: Funing was ordered to station at Xiangyang to supervise pursuit of heterodox-sect case criminals.
translations.idiomatic: Funing was posted to Xiangyang to pursue sect-case offenders.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以校正石經，加彭元瑞太子少保銜。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, for collating the Stone Classics, Peng Yuanrui was given the additional title of Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Peng Yuanrui received Junior Mentor rank for Stone Classics work.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賑廣東高要等縣水災。

translations.literal: On guimao day, flood disaster in counties including Gao in Guangdong was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, flood relief reached Gao and other Guangdong counties.

sentences.zh: 以湖北來鳳縣教匪段漢榮等糾眾拒捕，諭責畢沅廢弛。

translations.literal: Because sect rebel Duan Hanrong of Laifeng county, Hubei, had gathered a crowd to resist arrest, Bi Yuan was rebuked for negligence.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Hanrong's resistance in Laifeng brought a rebuke to Bi Yuan for slackness.

sentences.zh: 戊申，免齊齊哈爾等三城水災逋賦。

translations.literal: On wushen day, accumulated tax arrears from flood disaster in three cities including Qiqihar were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, flood back taxes were forgiven in Qiqihar and two other cities.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，免河南汲縣等九縣、山東臨清等十州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day bingchen: accumulated tax arrears were remitted for nine counties including Ji in Henan and ten prefectures and counties in Shandong including Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter tenth month, on bingchen day, back taxes were forgiven in nine Henan counties including Ji and ten Shandong districts including Linqing.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，勒保奏獲邪教首犯劉松。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Lebao memorialized capture of heterodox sect ringleader Liu Song.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Lebao reported Liu Song, the sect chief, captured.

sentences.zh: 命安徽嚴緝其徒劉之協。

translations.literal: Anhui was ordered strictly to pursue his follower Liu Zhixie.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui was told to arrest his follower Liu Zhixie.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，荷蘭入貢。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the Netherlands presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Dutch sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，免福建漳州府屬四廳州縣本年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On yichou day, this year's quota tax from flood disaster in four subprefectures and counties under Zhangzhou prefecture, Fujian, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, this year's flood tax was forgiven in four Zhangzhou-area Fujian districts.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命將科布多威豁爾等七卡移駐原處北界，餘地賞杜爾伯特汗瑪克素爾札布等游牧。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, it was ordered that the seven passes of Kobdo Weihuo'er and others be moved back to garrison on the former northern frontier; the remaining land was granted as pasture to the Khalkha prince Makusuerzhabu and others.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, seven Kobdo passes returned to the old north line; surplus land went to Prince Makusuerzhabu and other Khalkhas for grazing.

sentences.zh: 己卯，調陳用敷為湖北巡撫，惠齡為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Chen Yongfu was transferred to be Hubei governor and Huiling Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Chen Yongfu took Hubei and Huiling took Anhui.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，釋恆秀罪。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Hengxiu's crime was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Hengxiu was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，以河南扶溝縣知縣劉清鼐疏防劉之協潛逃，革逮，穆和藺下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingxu: because Liu Qingnai, magistrate of Fugou county, Henan, had been negligent in guarding against Liu Zhixie's secret flight, he was dismissed and arrested; Mu Helian was referred to the Board for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingxu day, Liu Qingnai was seized for letting Liu Zhixie escape and Mu Helian faced board discipline.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，免山東臨清等州縣本年漕賦。

translations.literal: On renchen day, this year's grain tribute transport tax was remitted for prefectures and counties in Shandong including Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, this year's tribute grain tax was forgiven in Linqing-area Shandong.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命富綱署刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Fugang was ordered to act as Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Fugang acted as punishments minister.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，穆和藺褫職，發烏魯木齊效力。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Mu Helian was stripped of office and sent to serve at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Mu Helian lost office and was sent to Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 以阿精阿為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Ajing'a was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ajing'a became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，普免各省積年逋賦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingchen: accumulated tax arrears through the years were universally remitted in all provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingchen day, all provinces' multi-year back taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙子，吏部尚書金簡卒，以保寧代之。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Minister of Personnel Jin Jian died; Baoning replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Jin Jian died and Baoning took personnel.

sentences.zh: 以明亮為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Mingliang was made Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang became Ili general.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命舒亮為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Shuliang was made Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Shuliang became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 改綏遠城將軍圖桑阿為西安將軍，以永琨代之。

translations.literal: Suiyuan general Tusang'a was changed to Xi'an general, with Yongkun replacing him.
translations.idiomatic: Tusang'a moved from Suiyuan to Xi'an; Yongkun took Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 六十年春正月甲申朔，日食，免朝賀。

translations.literal: Sixtieth year, spring, first month, new moon on day jiashen: there was a solar eclipse; court congratulations were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year, on the spring new moon, an eclipse spared the court levee.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑直隸天津等二十州縣、河南汲縣等十四縣、山東臨清等十州縣上年被水貧民有差。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, poor people last year stricken by flood in twenty prefectures and counties in Zhili including Tianjin, fourteen counties in Henan including Ji, and ten prefectures and counties in Shandong including Linqing were given relief by varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, last year's flood poor in Tianjin-area Zhili, Ji-area Henan, and Linqing-area Shandong were relieved by degree.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，召蘇凌阿來京，調福寧為兩江總督，復以畢沅為湖廣總督，玉德為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Suling'a was summoned to the capital; Funing was transferred to be governor-general of the Two Jiangs; Bi Yuan again became Huguang governor-general and Yude Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Suling'a was recalled; Funing took the Two Jiangs; Bi Yuan returned to Huguang and Yude to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 戊子，調陳用敷為貴州巡撫，英善為湖北巡撫，畢沅兼署。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Chen Yongfu was transferred to be Guizhou governor, Yingshan Hubei governor, with Bi Yuan additionally to act.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Chen Yongfu took Guizhou, Yingshan Hubei, and Bi Yuan acted.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以固倫額駙豐紳殷德為內務府大臣。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, imperial son-in-law Fengshen Yinde was made Minister of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Fengshen Yinde joined the Imperial Household ministry.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，免山東積年逋賦。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, accumulated tax arrears in Shandong were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Shandong's multi-year back taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，免江蘇積年逋賦。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, accumulated tax arrears in Jiangsu were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Jiangsu's multi-year back taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 免江西應緩徵銀穀。

translations.literal: Silver and grain due for deferred collection in Jiangxi were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi deferred silver and grain collection was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑朔，免廣東積年逋賦。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day guichou: accumulated tax arrears in Guangdong were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the second-month new moon, Guangdong's multi-year back taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 陳用敷以查拏要犯劉之協辦理錯謬，褫職逮問。

translations.literal: Chen Yongfu was stripped of office and arrested for errors in pursuing and seizing the important criminal Liu Zhixie.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yongfu was dismissed and arrested over the Liu Zhixie chase.

sentences.zh: 調姚棻為貴州巡撫，以成林為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Yao Fen was transferred to be Guizhou governor, with Cheng Lin made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Fen took Guizhou and Cheng Lin took Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，免陝西積年逋賦。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, accumulated tax arrears in Shaanxi were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Shaanxi's multi-year back taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 貴州松桃廳苗匪石柳鄧等、湖南永綏苗匪石三保等作亂。

translations.literal: Miao bandits including Shi Liudeng in Songtao subprefecture, Guizhou, and Shi Sanbao in Yongshui, Hunan, rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Liudeng in Guizhou's Songtao and Shi Sanbao in Hunan's Yongshui led Miao uprisings.

sentences.zh: 戊午，湖南苗匪陷乾州廳，同知宋如椿等死之。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Hunan Miao bandits took Qianzhou subprefecture; Assistant Prefect Song Ruchun and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Miao rebels seized Qianzhou and Song Ruchun fell.

sentences.zh: 命福康安往剿，畢沅駐常德籌辦糧餉。

translations.literal: Fukang'an was ordered to go to suppress them; Bi Yuan was stationed at Changde to manage grain and funds.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an was sent to fight them; Bi Yuan handled supplies at Changde.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以大學士阿桂等書上諭不能稱旨，停甄敘，侍郎成策等下部議處。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, because memorials with edicts from Grand Secretary Agui and others did not please the Emperor, merit registration was suspended and Vice Minister Cheng Ce and others were referred to the boards for disciplinary action.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Agui's memorial language failed and Cheng Ce and others faced discipline while rewards were held.

sentences.zh: 予總督福康安等議敘。

translations.literal: Governor-general Fukang'an and others were entered for merit review.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an and other governors were listed for rewards.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，貴州苗匪圍鎮遠鎮總兵珠隆阿於正大營。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Guizhou Miao bandits besieged Brigadier Zhuolong'a at Zhengda camp in Zhenyuan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Guizhou Miao rebels besieged Zhuolong'a at Zhengda camp.

sentences.zh: 免奉天廣寧、錦州旗地逋賦。

translations.literal: Accumulated tax arrears on banner lands in Guangning and Jinzhou, Fengtian, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian banner land back taxes at Guangning and Jinzhou were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 免甘肅皋蘭等四十五州縣積年逋賦。

translations.literal: Accumulated tax arrears in forty-five prefectures and counties in Gansu including Gaolan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu's forty-five districts including Gaolan had multi-year back taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命四川總督和琳赴酉陽州備苗，孫士毅仍留四川辦理報銷。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Sichuan Governor-General Helin was ordered to proceed to Youyang prefecture against the Miao; Sun Shiyi remained in Sichuan to handle settlement accounts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Helin went to Youyang against the Miao while Sun Shiyi stayed in Sichuan for accounts.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，免浙江積年民地灶地逋賦。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, accumulated tax arrears on civilian and saltern lands in Zhejiang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Zhejiang's civilian and saltern back taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 己巳，苗匪陷永綏廳鴉酉寨，鎮筸鎮總兵明安圖等死之。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Miao bandits took Yaxi stockade in Yongshui subprefecture; Brigadier Ming'antu and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Miao rebels took Yaxi in Yongshui and Ming'antu fell.

sentences.zh: 辛未，湖南永順苗匪張廷仲等作亂，擾保靖、瀘溪。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Yongshun Miao bandit Zhang Tingzhong and others rose in rebellion, harassing Baojing and Luxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Zhang Tingzhong's Yongshun Miao rebels raided Baojing and Luxi.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免安徽積年逋賦。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, accumulated tax arrears in Anhui were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Anhui's multi-year back taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬午，貴州苗匪擾思南、印江一帶，竄入四川秀山。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Guizhou Miao bandits harassed Sinan and Yinjiang, penetrating into Xiushan, Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Guizhou Miao rebels raided Sinan and Yinjiang and entered Sichuan's Xiushan.

sentences.zh: 福康安赴銅仁督剿。

translations.literal: Fukang'an went to Tongren to supervise suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an moved to Tongren to command.

sentences.zh: 命德楞泰領巴圖魯侍衛等赴貴州軍營。

translations.literal: Delengtai was ordered to lead Baturu bodyguards and others to the Guizhou army camp.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai was sent with Baturu guards to the Guizhou front.

sentences.zh: 閏二月乙酉，福康安奏解正大營之圍。

translations.literal: Intercalary second month, day yiyou: Fukang'an memorialized relief of the siege at Zhengda camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month, on yiyou day, Fukang'an reported Zhengda camp relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，馮光熊留為貴州巡撫，調姚棻為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Feng Guangxiong remained Guizhou governor; Yao Fen was transferred to be Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Feng Guangxiong stayed in Guizhou and Yao Fen took Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 以苗匪亂，免貴州銅仁府屬松桃、正大等處額賦。

translations.literal: Because of the Miao rebellion, quota tax was remitted in places including Songtao and Zhengda under Tongren prefecture, Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao rising brought tax relief in Tongren-area Songtao and Zhengda.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上詣東陵，免經過地方錢糧十分之三。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the Emperor went to the Eastern Tombs; land tax and grain levies on the route were remitted by three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs with a three-tenths tax cut on the route.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the Emperor paid respects at Zhaoxiling, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, and Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Emperor worshipped at four imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，福康安奏解嗅腦圍。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Fukang'an memorialized relief of the encirclement at Xiunao.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Fukang'an reported Xiunao relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，福康安奏攻克石城，剿除岩洞苗匪。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Fukang'an memorialized capture of Shicheng and elimination of Miao bandits in cave strongholds.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Fukang'an reported Shicheng taken and cave Miao cleared.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上謁泰陵、泰東陵，尊孝賢皇后陵。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the Emperor paid respects at Tailing and Taidongling and honored Empress Xiaoxian's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor worshipped at Tai tombs and Empress Xiaoxian's tomb.

sentences.zh: 免兩淮場灶積欠。

translations.literal: Accumulated arrears at the Two Huai salterns were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Two Huai saltern debts were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊申，福康安奏解松桃之圍。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Fukang'an memorialized relief of the siege at Songtao.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Fukang'an reported Songtao relieved.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，和琳奏肅清秀山後路，命往松桃與福康安會剿。

translations.literal: Third month, day yimao: Helin memorialized securing the Xiushan rear route and was ordered to proceed to Songtao to join Fukang'an in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yimao day, Helin secured Xiushan's rear and was sent to Songtao with Fukang'an.

sentences.zh: 以孫士毅署四川總督。

translations.literal: Sun Shiyi was ordered to act as Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shiyi acted as Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己未，福康安奏殄除長沖、卡落苗匪，進兵楚境。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Fukang'an memorialized extermination of Miao bandits at Changchong and Kaluo and advance into Chu territory.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Fukang'an cleared Changchong and Kaluo and entered Hunan.

sentences.zh: 命額勒登保迅赴福康安軍營。

translations.literal: Eleuthanbao was ordered hastily to proceed to Fukang'an's army camp.
translations.idiomatic: Eleuthanbao was rushed to Fukang'an's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 己卯，福康安奏解湖南永綏匪圍。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Fukang'an memorialized relief of the siege at Yongshui in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Fukang'an reported Yongshui in Hunan relieved.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，台灣彰化匪徒陳周全等作亂，陷縣城，尋復之。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day xinmao: bandits Chen Zhouquan and others in Changhua, Taiwan, rebelled, took the county seat, and soon it was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on xinmao day, Taiwan rebels Chen Zhouquan seized Changhua, but the city was soon retaken.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，竇光鼐以會試衡文失當，降調。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Dou Guangnai was demoted for improper examination judging at the metropolitan exam.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Dou Guangnai was demoted for faulty metropolitan-exam grading.

sentences.zh: 以朱珪為左都御史，仍留廣東巡撫任。

translations.literal: Zhu Gui was made Left Censor-in-Chief while remaining Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Gui became left censor-in-chief and kept the Guangdong governorship.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以魁倫劾洋盜肆行，命浦霖來京候旨，調姚棻為福建巡撫，以魁倫署之，江蘭為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jihai, because Kui Lun impeached unchecked foreign pirates, Pu Lin was ordered to Beijing to await instructions; Yao Fen was transferred to Fujian governor; Kui Lun acted in the post; Jiang Lan became Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Pu Lin was recalled over piracy charges, Yao Fen was sent to Fujian, Kui Lun acted, and Jiang Lan took Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賜王以銜等一百十一人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Wang Yixian and one hundred eleven others received jinshi degrees with differentiated ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Wang Yixian and 111 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賞會試薦卷文理較優之舉人徐炘、傅淦、李端內閣中書。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the licentiates Xu Xin, Fu Gan, and Li Duan, whose metropolitan exam papers were superior in style, were rewarded with Secretariat drafter posts.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Xu Xin, Fu Gan, and Li Duan became Secretariat drafters for superior exam papers.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上詣廣潤祠祈雨。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor went to the Guangrun Shrine to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Guangrun Shrine.

sentences.zh: 是夜，雨。

translations.literal: That night, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell that night.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免貴州官兵經過地方本年額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, quota land tax for places traversed by Guizhou troops and officials this year was remitted by varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Guizhou transit districts received partial land-tax remissions.

sentences.zh: 福康安等奏克黃瓜寨。

translations.literal: Fukang'an and others memorialized capture of Huangguazhai.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an reported taking Huangguazhai.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以福寧、惠齡經理湖南軍務未竣，命蘇凌阿仍署兩江總督，費淳為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, because Fu Ning and Hui Ling had not finished managing Hunan military affairs, Su Ling'a was again ordered to act as Liangjiang governor-general and Fei Chun made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Su Ling'a again acted at Liangjiang and Fei Chun took Anhui while Hunan affairs continued.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，免福建龍溪等四縣上年水災額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, last year's flood quota land tax was remitted for four Fujian counties including Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Longxi and three other Fujian counties were forgiven last year's flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 匪首陳周全等伏誅。

translations.literal: Bandit leaders Chen Zhouquan and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhouquan and other rebel leaders were executed.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，上幸避暑山莊。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingchen: the Emperor went to the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingchen day, the Emperor went to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 伍拉納、浦霖以辦理災賑不善，褫職鞫治。

translations.literal: Wulara and Pu Lin were stripped of office and tried for mismanaging disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: Wulara and Pu Lin were dismissed and prosecuted for botched relief.

sentences.zh: 命魁倫兼署閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Kui Lun was ordered to act concurrently as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Kui Lun was ordered to act as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 免經過地方本年錢糧十分之三。

translations.literal: This year's land tax and grain levies were remitted by three-tenths for places traversed.
translations.idiomatic: Transit districts received a thirty-percent tax remission.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，調費淳為江蘇巡撫，仍留惠齡為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Fei Chun was transferred to Jiangsu governor and Hui Ling remained Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Fei Chun took Jiangsu and Hui Ling stayed in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 福康安等奏克構皮寨及蘇皮寨等處。

translations.literal: Fukang'an and others memorialized capture of Goupi Stockade and Supi Stockade and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an reported captures at Goupi, Supi, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 調福康安為閩浙總督，勒保為四川總督。

translations.literal: Fukang'an was transferred to Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Lebao to Sichuan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an became Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Lebao Sichuan governor.

sentences.zh: 以宜綿為陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Yi Mian was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Mian became Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Emperor stayed at the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以福建倉庫虧缺查實，申飭科道無人奏及，並命嗣後陳奏地方重大事件，毋忝言責。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, because Fujian granary deficits were verified, censors were sternly rebuked for failing to memorialize, and it was ordered that hereafter they memorialize major local events without failing their duty to speak.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, censors were rebuked over Fujian warehouse deficits and told to report major local affairs.

sentences.zh: 召阿精阿來京，以景安為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Ajing'a was summoned to the capital; Jing'an was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ajing'a was summoned to Beijing and Jing'an became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，召惠齡來京，以汪新為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Hui Ling was summoned to the capital; Wang Xin made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Hui Ling was recalled and Wang Xin took Anhui.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命蘇凌阿駐清江浦，兼署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Su Ling'a was ordered to station at Qingjiangpu and act concurrently as Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Su Ling'a was stationed at Qingjiangpu acting as Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以于敏中營私玷職，褫輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Yu Minzhong was stripped of his Light Chariot Commandant hereditary title for private gain and breach of duty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Yu Minzhong lost his hereditary commandant title for corruption.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，以湖南苗匪擾鎮筸後路，諭責福寧怯懦，劉君輔株守。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renwu: because Hunan Miao bandits had raided the Zhenjiao rear route, an edict rebuked Fu Ning for cowardice and Liu Junfu for passive defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Fu Ning was rebuked for cowardice and Liu Junfu for passivity after Miao raided Zhenjiao's rear.

sentences.zh: 命惠齡仍署湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Hui Ling was again ordered to act as Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: Hui Ling was again ordered to act as Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以旱命刑部清理庶獄，減徒以下罪，承德府如之。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, because of drought the Ministry of Justice was ordered to clear ordinary prisons and commute punishments below exile; the Rehe Prefecture likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, drought led to prison reviews and commutations below exile in Beijing and Rehe.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，福康安等奏克沙兜、多喜等處苗寨。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Fukang'an and others memorialized capture of Miao stockades at Shadou, Duoxi, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Fukang'an reported taking Shadou, Duoxi, and other stockades.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賑廣東南海等縣水災。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, flood relief was given for the water disaster in Guangdong's Nanhai and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Nanhai and other Guangdong counties received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 戊申，姚棻以質訊解任，命魁倫兼署福建巡撫，長麟署閩浙總督。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Yao Fen was removed pending interrogation; Kui Lun was ordered to act concurrently as Fujian governor and Changlin acted as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Yao Fen was suspended, Kui Lun acted as Fujian governor, and Changlin as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，德明以罣累滋陽縣知縣陳照自縊，論絞。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengshen: Deming, implicated through Yiyang magistrate Chen Zhao, hanged himself and was sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Deming hanged himself and received a strangulation sentence over the Chen Zhao affair.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，免湖北江陵等十二州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yichou, last year's flood quota land tax was remitted for twelve Jiangling and other Hubei prefectures, counties, and garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, twelve Hubei jurisdictions including Jiangling were forgiven last year's flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以福康安等奏連克苗寨，渡大烏草河，賚珍物。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, because Fukang'an and others memorialized successive captures of Miao stockades and crossing the Great Wucao River, precious gifts were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Fukang'an was rewarded for successive stockade captures and crossing the Great Wucao River.

sentences.zh: 壬申，哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖等入覲，召見賜茶。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Jebtsundamba Khutuktu and others had audience; they were summoned and given tea.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Jebtsundamba Khutuktu and others were received and given tea.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，調永琨為烏里雅蘇台將軍，恆瑞為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renwu: Yongkun was transferred to Uliastai general and Hengrui to Suiyuan city general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Yongkun took Uliastai and Hengrui Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賜南掌國王召溫猛、緬甸國王孟隕敕諭，均賚文綺。

translations.literal: On day guimao, imperial letters of instruction were bestowed on Nanzhang king Zhao Wenmeng and Burma king Meng Xian, each with patterned silks.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, letters and silks went to the Nanzhang and Burma kings.

sentences.zh: 丙申，允兵部尚書劉峨乞休，以朱珪代之，仍留廣東巡撫任。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Liu E's request to retire was granted; Zhu Gui replaced him while remaining Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Liu E retired and Zhu Gui replaced him while keeping Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 以金士松為左都御史。

translations.literal: Jin Shisong was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shisong became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免直隸通州等五十二州縣積欠旗租。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, accumulated banner rent arrears were remitted for fifty-two Zhili prefectures and counties including Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, banner rent arrears were forgiven in fifty-two Zhili districts including Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 福康安等進駐楊柳坪。

translations.literal: Fukang'an and others advanced to encamp at Yangliuping.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an advanced to Yangliuping.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，上御勤政殿，召皇子、皇孫、王、公、大臣等入見，宣示立皇十五子嘉親王為皇太子，明年為嗣皇帝嘉慶元年。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinhai: the Emperor held court at the Diligence in Government Hall, summoned princes, imperial grandsons, princes and dukes, and ministers for audience, and proclaimed the fifteenth imperial son, Prince Jia, heir apparent, with the following year as the Jiaqing first year of the succeeding emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Emperor proclaimed Prince Jia heir apparent and fixed the next year as Jiaqing 1.

sentences.zh: 撫恤江蘇海州等七州縣水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for the water disaster in seven Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Jiangsu districts including Haizhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，皇太子及王、公、內外文武大臣，蒙古王、公等各奏籲請俟壽躋期頤，再舉行歸政典禮，不允。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Heir Apparent and princes, dukes, civil and military ministers inside and outside, and Mongol princes and dukes each memorialized begging that abdication ceremonies wait until the Emperor reached the fullness of long life; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the court begged to defer abdication until the Emperor's full longevity; he refused.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，富勒渾、雅德以前總督婪贓，均褫職，分別發熱河、伊犁效力。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Fulehun and Yade, for earlier governorship corruption, were both stripped of office and sent to serve at Rehe and Ili respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Fulehun and Yade were dismissed for past graft and sent to Rehe and Ili.

sentences.zh: 己未，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor reviewed the Jianrui Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor inspected the Jianrui Camp.

sentences.zh: 晉封福康安忠銳嘉勇貝子，和琳一等宣勇伯。

translations.literal: Fukang'an was advanced to Loyal Valiant Brave Prince with courage and He Lin to first-class Baron Xuanyong.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an was made Loyal Valiant Brave Prince and He Lin Baron Xuanyong.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上命皇太子謁東陵、西陵。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor ordered the Heir Apparent to visit the Eastern and Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Heir Apparent was sent to the Eastern and Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，黑龍江將軍舒亮以婪索，褫職鞫治，調永琨代之。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Heilongjiang general Shuliang, for extortion, was stripped of office and tried; Yongkun was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Shuliang was prosecuted for extortion and Yongkun replaced him at Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 命圖桑阿為烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: Tusang'a was made Uliastai general.
translations.idiomatic: Tusang'a became Uliastai general.

sentences.zh: 改恆瑞為西安將軍，以烏爾圖納遜代之。

translations.literal: Hengrui was changed to Xi'an general and replaced by Wuer'tunaxun.
translations.idiomatic: Hengrui became Xi'an general and Wuer'tunaxun replaced him.

sentences.zh: 命博興為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: Boxing was made Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Boxing became Chahar commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 調特克慎為庫倫辦事大臣，策巴克為西寧辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Tekesen was transferred to Urga minister and Cebake to Xining minister.
translations.idiomatic: Tekesen took Urga and Cebake Xining.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，明亮以任黑龍江將軍時侵漁貂皮褫職，命保寧為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Mingliang was stripped of office for embezzling sable pelts while Heilongjiang general; Baoning was made Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Mingliang lost his post for sable embezzlement and Baoning became Ili general.

sentences.zh: 己巳，舒亮論絞。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Shuliang was sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Shuliang was sentenced to strangulation.

sentences.zh: 明亮留烏魯木齊效力。

translations.literal: Mingliang was kept at Urumchi to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang remained to serve at Urumchi.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以奉天、山西、四川、湖南、貴州、廣西賦無逋欠，免明年正賦十分之二。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, because Fengtian, Shanxi, Sichuan, Hunan, Guizhou, and Guangxi had no tax arrears, two-tenths of next year's main levy was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, six provinces with no arrears received twenty percent off next year's main tax.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，免福建龍溪等六縣，華封、羅溪二縣上年被水額賦。

translations.literal: On day yihai, last year's flood quota land tax was remitted for six Fujian counties including Longxi and Hua Feng and Luoxi counties.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, six Fujian counties and two districts were forgiven last year's flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅朔，頒嘉慶元年時憲書。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on day wuyin: calendars for Jiaqing year 1 were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: At the tenth-month new moon, Jiaqing 1 calendars were issued.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，福康安等奏擒匪首吳半生。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Fukang'an and others memorialized capture of bandit chief Wu Bansheng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Fukang'an reported capturing Wu Bansheng.

sentences.zh: 賞福康安之子德麟副都統銜，和琳黃帶，餘議敘賞賚有差。

translations.literal: Fukang'an's son Delin was granted vice censorate-in-chief rank; He Lin yellow sash; the rest received differentiated merit rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Delin received vice censor rank, He Lin a yellow sash, and others rewards by degree.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以伍拉納等貪黷敗檢，戍其子於伊犁。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, because Wulara and others were corrupt and disgraced their office, their sons were banished to serve at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Wulara's sons were banished to Ili for his corruption.

sentences.zh: 長麟以徇庇伍拉納、浦霖褫職，命來京。

translations.literal: Changlin was stripped of office for shielding Wulara and Pu Lin and ordered to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Changlin was dismissed for covering for Wulara and Pu Lin and summoned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以魁倫署閩浙總督，姚棻署福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Kui Lun was ordered to act as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Yao Fen to act as Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: Kui Lun acted as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Yao Fen as Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，普免天下嘉慶元年地丁錢糧。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, land-tax grain for Jiaqing year 1 was wholly remitted empire-wide.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the empire's Jiaqing 1 land taxes were wholly remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，伍拉納、浦霖處斬。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Wulara and Pu Lin were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Wulara and Pu Lin were executed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以額勒登保、德楞泰剿捕苗匪奮勇，授內大臣。

translations.literal: On day renchen, because E'erdengbao and Delengtai were valiant in suppressing Miao bandits, they were made inner ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, E'erdengbao and Delengtai became inner ministers for suppressing Miao rebels.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命定丙辰年傳位典禮。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, ceremonies for transferring the throne in the bingchen year were ordered fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the bingchen abdication rites were ordered arranged.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命明年正月初吉，重舉千叟宴。

translations.literal: On day guimao, on the auspicious first day of next year's New Year the Feast of a Thousand Elders was ordered held again.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, another Thousand Elders Banquet was ordered for New Year.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，福康安等奏克天星寨等處。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingsi: Fukang'an and others memorialized capture of Tianxing Stockade and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Fukang'an reported Tianxing Stockade and elsewhere captured.

sentences.zh: 加和琳太子少保銜，賞福康安、和琳上用黃里玄狐端罩各一。

translations.literal: He Lin was given Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent rank; Fukang'an and He Lin each received one upper-grade yellow-lined black-fox surcoat.
translations.idiomatic: He Lin became Junior Guardian; Fukang'an and He Lin each received a distinguished fur coat.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賑奉天金州、熊岳、錦州三城，寧海等三州縣旱災旗民，免額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, drought relief was given to banner people in Jinzhou, Xiongyue, and Jinzhou cities in Fengtian and three counties including Ninghai, with quota tax remitted by varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Fengtian drought districts were relieved and taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上命皇太子居毓慶宮。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Emperor ordered the Heir Apparent to reside in the Yuying Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Heir Apparent moved to Yuying Palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅朔，諭曰：「朕於明年歸政後，凡有繕奏事件，俱書太上皇帝。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day wuyin, an edict said: "After I abdicate next year, all memorial matters submitted are to be addressed to the Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: At the twelfth-month new moon, an edict required memorials after abdication to name the Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 其奏對稱太上皇。

translations.literal: In audience they are to address him as Retired Emperor."
translations.idiomatic: In audience they are to call him Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，賑貴州銅仁被擾難民。

translations.literal: "" (closing quotation mark in the source.) On day wuzi, relief was given to refugees disturbed in Tongren, Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The edict ended." On wuzi day, Tongren refugees in Guizhou were relieved.

sentences.zh: 福康安等奏克天星等苗寨。

translations.literal: Fukang'an and others memorialized capture of Tianxing and other Miao stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an reported Tianxing and other stockades taken.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，允朱珪收英吉利國王表貢，賜敕嘉賚，交英商波郎齎回，並以其表言勸廓爾喀投順，於賜敕內以無須英國兵力告之。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Zhu Gui was permitted to receive the memorial tribute of the king of England; an imperial letter of grace was bestowed and handed to the English merchant Pao Lang to carry back; and because the memorial urged Gurkha to submit, the letter told them no English military force was needed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Zhu Gui received Britain's tribute and a letter told Gurkha that English troops were unnecessary.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賜琉球國王尚溫敕諭。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, an imperial letter of instruction was bestowed on Ryukyu king Sho On.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Ryukyu's king received an imperial letter.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以來歲元旦，傳位皇太子為嗣皇帝，前期遣官告祭天地宗社。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, because at New Year next year the throne would be transferred to the Heir Apparent as succeeding emperor, officials were dispatched beforehand to announce sacrifice to Heaven and Earth and the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, envoys were sent to announce the New Year transfer of the throne.

sentences.zh: 是歲，緬甸、南掌、暹羅、安南、英吉利、琉球、廓爾喀來貢。

translations.literal: That year Burma, Nanzhang, Siam, Annam, England, Ryukyu, and Gurkha came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year seven states sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年正月戊申朔，舉行授受大典，立皇太子為皇帝。

translations.literal: Jiaqing year 1, first month, new moon on day wushen: the ceremony of transmitting and receiving the great seals was held; the Heir Apparent was installed as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiaqing 1 New Year the abdication ceremony installed the Heir Apparent as emperor.

sentences.zh: 尊上為太上皇帝，軍國重務仍奏聞，秉訓裁決，大事降旨敕。

translations.literal: The Emperor was honored as Retired Emperor; important military and state affairs were still reported, following his instruction in judgment; great affairs received edicts and decrees from him.
translations.idiomatic: The retired Emperor still decided weighty affairs while routine matters were reported to him.

sentences.zh: 宮中時憲書用乾隆年號。

translations.literal: Court calendars still used the Qianlong reign title.
translations.idiomatic: Palace calendars still read Qianlong.

sentences.zh: 三年冬，上不豫。

translations.literal: Winter of year 3, the Emperor grew ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the third winter the retired Emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 四年正月壬戌崩，壽八十有九。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, day renxu: he died, aged eighty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on renxu day, he died at eighty-nine.

sentences.zh: 是年，四月乙未，上尊諡曰法天隆運至誠先覺體元立極敷文奮武孝慈神聖純皇帝，廟號高宗。

translations.literal: That year, fourth month, day yiwei: the posthumous honorific Fatian Longyun Zhicheng Xianjue Tiyuan Liji Fuwen Fenwu Xiaoci Shensheng Chun Emperor was respectfully submitted; temple name Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: That year the full posthumous title and temple name Gaozong were conferred.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，葬裕陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengwu: burial at Yuling Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, he was buried at Yuling.

sentences.zh: 論曰：高宗運際郅隆，勵精圖治，開疆拓宇，四征不庭，揆文奮武，於斯為盛。

translations.literal: The commentators say: Gaozong's fortune met utmost prosperity; he strove in government, expanded territory, on four sides punished those who would not submit, balanced culture with martial vigor—at this peak it was magnificent.
translations.idiomatic: The annalists say Gaozong ruled at supreme fortune, expanding the realm and balancing wen and wu as never before.

sentences.zh: 享祚之久，同符圣祖，而壽考則逾之。

translations.literal: The length of his reign matched the Sacred Ancestor, yet in longevity he surpassed him.
translations.idiomatic: His reign equaled Kangxi's, but his years exceeded them.

sentences.zh: 自三代以後，未嘗有也。

translations.literal: Since the Three Dynasties, there had never been such a case.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing like it had occurred since the Three Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 惟耄期倦勤，蔽於權倖，上累日月之明，為之嘆息焉。

translations.literal: Only in old age, wearied of toil, he was misled by favorites in power, which dimmed the brilliance of his years—for this one sighs.
translations.idiomatic: Only in old age, blinded by powerful favorites, did he cloud his glory—and at that one sighs.
